techniques.name: orbit-reveal
techniques.title: Orbit around a stationary subject
techniques.prompt_text:
Cinematic orbit shot circling [Subject] once at constant radius and speed, subject
stays perfectly still and centred while the background rotates behind it, 85mm,
even key light so the falloff does not betray the move, no dolly zoom.
techniques.lede_text:
An orbit is the cheapest way to show that an object has depth: because the subject
is static and only the background moves, every edge that reveals a new face proves
the object is three-dimensional rather than a flat render.
techniques.when_to_use_text:
Product reveals, character introductions that need scale, and any moment where you
want to say "look at all of this" without cutting.
techniques.directing_text:
Say "orbit" and then forbid the two failure modes explicitly: no subject rotation,
no zoom. Constant radius and constant speed are what stop it reading as a handheld
wobble.
mistakes: The subject rotates with the camera, which destroys the parallax proof.
Speed easing, so the move breathes at the wrong moment.
Falling off a wide lens, which stretches the background as it turns.

techniques.name: product-macro-detail
techniques.title: Macro detail with a rack focus
techniques.prompt_text:
Extreme macro detail of [Subject] filling the frame, texture visible, focus racking
from the near surface to the far plane mid-shot, shallow depth of field, controlled
key light skimming across the surface, 100mm macro, no camera movement.
techniques.lede_text:
At macro distances depth of field becomes a few millimetres, so a focus pull is the
only move available. That constraint is useful: it turns attention into a physical
act the viewer can follow, rather than a cut that asks them to notice a difference.
techniques.when_to_use_text:
Material and texture proof, hardware close-ups, and detail shots that hand off to a
wider frame.
techniques.directing_text:
"Focus racks from the near surface to the far plane" plus "shallow depth of field" is
the mechanism. Pair it with a declared motion-card handoff so the rack lands on a
cut, which is what turns the pull into a transition.
mistakes: Too much depth of field, so the rack has nothing to travel through.
Adding camera movement to a technique that is entirely about focus.
Racking too fast to read either plane.

techniques.name: slow-dolly-in
techniques.title: Slow dolly-in on a locked subject
techniques.prompt_text:
Cinematic shot of [Subject], slow steady dolly-in from a medium wide to a medium
close over about eight seconds, subject held at the same screen position, background
parallax sliding outward, 50mm on a dolly, locked horizon, no handheld shake.
techniques.lede_text:
A dolly-in changes the relationship between subject and background rather than
magnifying the frame. Everything behind the subject shifts in scale at a different
rate, so the move reads as travelling into the scene, not zooming at it.
techniques.when_to_use_text:
When you want to add weight to a statement, or move the viewer from context into
detail without cutting. It is the default move for an opening line and for a reveal.
techniques.directing_text:
Give the duration, the start and end framing, and the parallax explicitly. "Slow
dolly-in over eight seconds from medium wide to medium close, background
parallax" distinguishes it from a zoom, which the model will otherwise choose.
mistakes: Producing a zoom: background stays static, so the move reads as a flat scale-up.
Too fast. Under four seconds reads as a push, not a drift.
Handheld micro-shake, which reads as "amateur" rather than "cinematic".

techniques.name: butterfly-key
techniques.title: Butterfly key with under-light bounce
techniques.prompt_text:
Studio portrait of [Subject] under a butterfly key: the main light raised high and
tilted down so its shadow falls under the nose, a low reflector bouncing fill back
under the chin, black background, glamour lighting, 85mm, crisp catchlights.
techniques.lede_text:
Moving the key above the subject's eye line and tilting it down puts the nose
shadow under the nose rather than to one side. That single geometric change flattens
the face symmetrically, which is why fashion and beauty lighting has used it for a
century.
techniques.when_to_use_text:
Beauty and cosmetics work, skincare texture shots, any frontal hero image where
symmetry is the point. Not for interviews: the symmetrical shadow reads as
artificial in conversation.
techniques.directing_text:
Say "high key light tilted down, nose shadow falls beneath the nose, low bounce
reflector under the chin". The bounce is what keeps it from going harsh — without it
the under-chin area goes black and the face reads as a mask.
mistakes: The shadow lands to the side, so the AI placed the key at eye level. Name the
Omitting the bounce and getting a harsh, dark underside.
Flash-on-the-lens look: a frontal catchlight instead of two angled ones.

techniques.name: kicker-light
techniques.title: Three-quarter backlight kicker
techniques.prompt_text:
Cinematic portrait of [Subject], three-quarter backlight, deep shadows on the near
side, a soft key picking out the cheekbone and shoulder line, subtle rim separating
the figure from a dark background, shallow depth of field, 35mm, anamorphic flare.
techniques.lede_text:
A hard backlight placed behind and roughly 40 degrees off the subject's axis does
two jobs at once: it draws a bright edge along the near cheek and shoulder, and it
lets the whole front of the figure fall into shadow. That contrast is what makes a
dark portrait read as lit rather than underexposed.
techniques.when_to_use_text:
Use it when the subject needs weight and separation but the environment should stay
quiet: product heroes on dark backgrounds, interview subjects against a dim room,
any shot where the silhouette is doing the storytelling.
techniques.directing_text:
State the key direction and the falloff explicitly. "Backlit" alone gets you a
window behind the subject; "backlight from camera-left at roughly 40 degrees, front
falls to shadow, rim highlights the near cheek and shoulder" gets you the shot.
Naming which side of the face is dark is the single highest-leverage clause.
mistakes: Filling the shadows. An AI that "balances the exposure" kills the contrast that
Rimming both sides, which flattens into a halo rather than an edge.
No background separation, so the rim merges into a bright wall.

techniques.name: low-key-single-source
techniques.title: Low-key single-source chiaroscuro
techniques.prompt_text:
Chiaroscuro portrait of [Subject] lit by a single low hard source from camera-right,
most of the frame falling into black, one narrow highlight along the brow and cheek,
deep unlit background, no fill, 50mm, film grain, Rembrandt lighting.
techniques.lede_text:
One source, no fill, and the parts of the face it misses are allowed to stay dark.
That is the whole technique: chiaroscuro is a subtraction problem, not a lighting
problem. Most prompts fail it by asking for "dramatic moody lighting" and getting
even, ambient darkness instead.
techniques.when_to_use_text:
Brand work that wants gravity, historical or period framing, and any shot where you
want the viewer to complete the missing information.
techniques.directing_text:
Name the single source, its position relative to the camera, and the absence of
fill. "No fill light, unlit side falls to black" is the clause that does the work.
Add a specific shape for the shadow — "a small triangle of light under the far eye"
— because "half the face is dark" gets you generic half-light.
mistakes: Adding ambient or bounce the prompt did not ask for; the shadow fills in.
Losing the shape: the light spills so wide there is no defined terminator.
Over-grading to black, which costs the subject any readable form.

techniques.name: centered-symmetry
techniques.title: Centred symmetry for hero objects
techniques.prompt_text:
Perfectly symmetrical product shot of [Subject] dead centre on the vertical axis,
mirrored surroundings, frontal even lighting, orthographic feel, 100mm, clean
seamless background, no perspective skew.
techniques.lede_text:
Symmetry is the composition for objects whose shape is the message. When the frame
is bisected and both halves match, the eye has nothing to resolve, and the object
reads as an icon rather than a photograph.
techniques.when_to_use_text:
Brand marks, product hero shots on flat backgrounds, and UI states where symmetry
signals precision. Avoid for anything with narrative, because symmetry has no
direction for the eye to travel.
techniques.directing_text:
"Perfectly symmetrical, dead centre, mirrored background" — the mirroring clause is
what makes it work, since the model will happily produce a centred object in an
asymmetric room.
mistakes: Near-symmetry: the axis is off by a few pixels, which the eye reads as sloppiness.
Perspective distortion from a wide lens, breaking the mirror.
Even lighting across a textured object, which flattens it.

techniques.name: negative-space-frame
techniques.title: Negative-space frame for a headline
techniques.prompt_text:
Cinematic frame of [Subject] small and placed low-right, the upper two thirds left
as clean empty wall, even soft light, no clutter, muted palette, 35mm, ample
headroom for a headline.
techniques.lede_text:
A frame with real empty space is a layout that has already reserved its own copy
area. Photographing with the composition you intend to typeset into is the
difference between a design that feels designed and one that feels assembled.
techniques.when_to_use_text:
Landing page heroes, social cards, and any shot that will carry a headline. Pair it
with the motion card that later demotes the title into a section label.
techniques.directing_text:
Give a proportion, not a vibe: "upper two thirds empty wall". "Lots of negative
space" produces an empty frame with the subject dead centre.
mistakes: Empty space that is not clean, so a headline lands on texture.
Subject placed on the third line but cropped by the frame edge.
Light falloff in the copy area, which makes text unreadable over it.

techniques.name: rule-of-thirds-subject
techniques.title: Off-centre subject with negative space
techniques.prompt_text:
Cinematic composition of [Subject] placed on the left third, looking into open
negative space on the right, eye line on the upper horizontal, background uncluttered
and darker than the subject, 35mm, rule of thirds.
techniques.lede_text:
A subject on a third line, looking into the space it occupies, is a frame that
already reads as a frame before anything happens in it. The negative space is not
empty: it is the room the shot is going to move into.
techniques.when_to_use_text:
Establishing shots, copy-led layouts, and any frame where you will later place text
or a product UI. The space you leave is the space you will need.
techniques.directing_text:
Say which third and which direction the subject looks. "Off-centre, negative space
on the right" is enough; "rule of thirds" alone gets you a centred subject, because
that is the model's default reading of a plain product shot.
mistakes: Centring everything, because "cinematic composition" biases toward symmetry.
Filling the negative space with objects, which leaves nowhere to breathe.
Horizon tangent to the subject's head, a classic tangency error.

techniques.name: hard-cut-on-beat
techniques.title: Hard cut on the beat
techniques.prompt_text:
Fast-cut montage on [Subject], every cut landing exactly on a drum transient, six to
twelve frames per shot, no dissolves, hard audio transient on each cut, 24fps
shutter, high contrast.
techniques.lede_text:
A cut on a transient reads as intentional because the ear and the eye arrive at the
same instant. A cut a few frames late reads as a mistake, and no amount of good
footage will fix the timing.
techniques.when_to_use_text:
Trailers, product hype reels, and the opening thirty seconds of a launch film. This
is the technique the upstream `music-beat-sync.md` methodology exists to support,
including its hard rule: measure real BPM first, then verify cut error is under
three frames against the rendered audio.
techniques.directing_text:
"Every cut lands exactly on the drum hit" plus a frame budget. Generate against a
known track rather than "to the music", which is the difference between a measurable
edit and a hopeful one.
mistakes: Cuts on the wrong transient — snare where the kick is.
Varying shot length below the readability floor, which becomes flicker.
Dissolves sneaking in, which smear the audio-image lock the technique needs.

techniques.name: match-cut-transition
techniques.title: Match cut on a shared silhouette
techniques.prompt_text:
Cinematic match cut: [Subject] in the first frame and a different scene in the
second frame share the same silhouette and screen position, hard cut on the shape,
no dissolve, matched camera height and focal length across both frames.
techniques.lede_text:
A match cut hides the edit by making the second frame arrive already aligned with
the first. The viewer perceives continuity because the silhouette lands where the
previous silhouette was, and never registers the cut itself.
techniques.when_to_use_text:
Transitions between a product and the problem it solves, between a UI state and a
physical object, and anywhere a hard cut would otherwise feel like a mistake.
techniques.directing_text:
Name both frames and the shared property. "Same silhouette, same screen position,
same camera height" is the specification; "smooth transition" gets you a dissolve,
which is the opposite of the intent.
mistakes: Getting a dissolve or a whip pan: say "hard cut, no transition effect".
Mismatched camera height, which breaks the alignment the cut depends on.
Silhouettes that are merely similar rather than identical in position.

techniques.name: single-take-reveal
techniques.title: Single-take reveal with one motivated move
techniques.prompt_text:
One continuous take on [Subject], beginning tight on a small detail and craning up
and back to reveal the full scene, no cuts, single continuous camera motion, focus
pull from the detail to the far plane as the move finishes, 35mm.
techniques.lede_text:
A single-take reveal earns attention by withholding. Nothing is hidden by a cut, so
the viewer learns the scale of the thing by experiencing the move rather than being
told it in a second shot.
techniques.when_to_use_text:
Product scale reveals, environment establishing shots, and any moment where a cut
would spend the reveal too early.
techniques.directing_text:
"Continuous single take, no cuts" has to be explicit — models add cuts freely. Name
the start and end of the move and the focus behaviour; the focus pull is what tells
the viewer the move has landed.
mistakes: A cut sneaking in mid-move.
Moving without a focus change, so the reveal has no punctuation.
Rising too fast to read the detail you started on.

techniques.name: problem-to-solution-beat
techniques.title: Problem-to-solution two-beat structure
techniques.prompt_text:
Two-beat product story: the first frame shows [Subject] mid-friction, the second
frame shows the same subject resolved and calm, matched framing and lighting across
both beats so only the state changes, 50mm, no text.
techniques.lede_text:
The most durable product structure is a state change, not a feature list. Two frames,
matched everything except the thing that is now solved. Because the camera language
does not change, the viewer reads the difference as a change in the world rather
than a change in the edit.
techniques.when_to_use_text:
Launch films, paid social, and anywhere a viewer has about eight seconds of
attention. It is also the structure the upstream 36.2s template is built on.
techniques.directing_text:
Ask for the matched pair explicitly: "identical framing and lighting in both beats".
Without that clause you get two different shots, and the comparison dies.
mistakes: Different lighting between beats, which makes it read as two products.
Solving the problem with a hard cut to a logo instead of to the product.
Adding on-screen text, which competes with the state change.

techniques.name: silent-observation-beat
techniques.title: Silent observation beat before the pitch
techniques.prompt_text:
Documentary-style beat of [Subject] observed in use with no presenter, no voiceover,
natural ambient light only, long unbroken take, hands and screen in frame, 35mm,
shallow focus, observational framing.
techniques.lede_text:
Showing the tool in someone's hands, unscripted, borrows credibility that a presenter
cannot manufacture. The absence of explanation is the technique: the viewer infers
the use case, and an inference is more persuasive than a claim.
techniques.when_to_use_text:
B2B and developer audiences, long-form landing pages, and anywhere a polished
presenter shot would read as an ad.
techniques.directing_text:
"No presenter, no voiceover, ambient light only" must all be said. The model
defaults to a polished studio look with a talking head, which is the exact opposite
of what is being asked.
mistakes: Drifting into a staged three-quarter hero angle mid-take.
Adding ambient music cues that signal "commercial".
Over-stabilising, which makes a handheld take look like a tripod.

techniques.name: analogue-texture
techniques.title: Analogue film texture, restrained
techniques.prompt_text:
Cinematic still of [Subject] shot on 35mm film, fine organic grain visible in the
shadows, slight halation around highlights, gently lifted blacks, muted filmic
colour, restrained contrast, no heavy vignette, 50mm.
techniques.lede_text:
Analogue texture is a *shadow* property first: grain lives in the low end, and
highlights bloom rather than clip. Adding visible grain over a clean digital render
reads as a filter; adding grain into the shadows of a real tonal curve reads as film.
techniques.when_to_use_text:
Brand work that wants warmth and imperfection, and as a counterweight to a corpus
that otherwise trends toward clean gradient UI motion.
techniques.directing_text:
"Grain visible in the shadows, halation around highlights" does the work. "Film
grain" on its own gets an even digital noise overlay across the whole frame.
mistakes: Uniform noise over the whole frame rather than concentrated in the shadows.
Crushed blacks, which kills the grain along with the detail.
Heavy vignette, which is a different look entirely (analogue lens falloff).

techniques.name: cold-blue-tech
techniques.title: Cold blue technical palette
techniques.prompt_text:
Cold blue technical frame of [Subject], cool desaturated palette, blue-grey metal,
soft gradient background, precise specular highlights, minimal saturation, clean
industrial surfaces, 50mm, high micro-contrast.
techniques.lede_text:
A palette does work when every colour in it has the same temperature. The cold blue
look survives scrutiny because nothing in the frame is warm enough to break it —
the failure mode is one skin-tone or one warm prop in a supposedly cool scene.
techniques.when_to_use_text:
Infrastructure and developer tooling, hardware, and enterprise work where "serious"
is the register being aimed at.
techniques.directing_text:
State the temperature constraint as a prohibition as well as a direction: "no warm
tones". A palette described only positively will still admit a warm accent.
mistakes: One warm element surviving in the background.
Over-saturating the blue until it reads as a filter rather than a material.
Losing micro-contrast, which turns "precise" into "soft".

techniques.name: restrained-motion-graphics
techniques.title: Restrained motion graphics for software
techniques.prompt_text:
Clean product motion frame showing [Subject] as a crisp UI surface on a flat dark
ground, one element moving with a single ease, everything else perfectly still,
precise 8px spacing grid, one accent colour used once, no decorative glow, 60fps.
techniques.lede_text:
The restraint is the style. When exactly one element moves on an 8-pixel grid with a
single ease, the movement reads as information; when four things move with
decorative easing, the same movement reads as a template.
techniques.when_to_use_text:
SaaS and developer tools, especially anything shipped alongside real UI. It also
matches the upstream rule set directly: one motion idea per shot, holds after every
key beat, no batch glows.
techniques.directing_text:
"One element moving, everything else still, single ease" is the clause. Without
"everything else still" you get every element animating, which is the failure this
style exists to avoid.
mistakes: Batch entrances with per-item easing, which reads as busy rather than precise.
Glow and bloom on UI elements, which makes flat design look dirty.
Sub-pixel positions that make the grid read as sloppy.

techniques.name: documentary-naturalism
techniques.title: Documentary naturalism
techniques.prompt_text:
Documentary shot of [Subject] in its real environment, available window light only,
handheld but composed, muted natural colour, no stylisation, slight exposure
irregularity, 35mm, observational distance.
techniques.lede_text:
Naturalism is a constraint list: existing light, real locations, no styling, no
clean-up. What it buys is belief. A viewer who suspects a set stops evaluating the
content and starts evaluating the production.
techniques.when_to_use_text: Testimonials, case studies, and anything where credibility matters more than polish.
techniques.directing_text:
"Available window light only, no stylisation, no colour grading" is the set of
clauses. Leave any of them out and the model applies its default commercial-grade
finish, which is exactly what the genre is avoiding.
mistakes: Styling the environment, which reads as a set.
Perfect exposure, which reads as a still rather than a frame from a moving shot.
Over-clean skin and walls, which is the fastest way to lose naturalism.

techniques.name: high-key-white-studio
techniques.title: High-key white studio product shot
techniques.prompt_text:
High-key studio product photograph of [Subject] on a seamless white sweep, soft
overhead key with a fill card, shadow falling softly beneath the object, colour
accurate, even exposure with no clipping, 100mm macro, commercial catalogue look.
techniques.lede_text:
High-key is an exposure discipline: keep every surface inside the range where the
material is still readable. Clip the white background and the object stops looking
like an object and starts looking like a shape cut out of paper.
techniques.when_to_use_text:
Catalogue and e-commerce, marketplaces, and any frame where the viewer needs to
judge the actual colour and material of the product.
techniques.directing_text:
"Even exposure, no clipping, colour accurate" plus "soft shadow beneath". Without
the clipping clause, white backgrounds blow out and take the product edge with them.
mistakes: Clipped highlights on a white object against white, which erases its silhouette.
Hard multiple shadows from an unstated multi-light setup.
Colour shifts from aggressive white balance.

techniques.name: retro-analogue-comedy
techniques.title: Retro analogue comedy framing
techniques.prompt_text:
Retro 1970s comedy scene with [Subject] shot on vintage 16mm, slightly soft focus,
visible gate weave, warm amber cast, wide static framing with the subject small in
frame, deadpan timing, no camera movement.
techniques.lede_text:
Genre framing is mostly about how much frame you leave empty and how still the
camera is. A 70s comedy shot is soft, warm, static and wide, and the stillness is
what leaves room for the timing to do the work.
techniques.when_to_use_text:
Humour, explainers that want warmth, and any brand that benefits from looking
handmade rather than clinical.
techniques.directing_text:
Name the stock and the framing: "vintage 16mm, warm amber, wide static framing,
subject small in frame". "Retro" alone produces a costume-drama look, not a comedy
one.
mistakes: Adding camera movement, which kills the deadpan timing the genre depends on.
Pushing the subject too large, which loses the dead air the jokes land in.
Over-sharpening, which reads as "old filter" instead of old film.

opportunities.title: B2B: branded skill + support SLA
opportunities.thesis: Upstream is Apache-2.0, so the code cannot be locked up. The defensible B2B product is the part that is NOT in the repo: a branded skill pinned to the client's design system, CI that renders on every PR, and an acceptance report per release.
opportunities.evidence: {"core_license": "Apache-2.0", "remotion_commercial": "requires licence for companies", "existing_ci": "pr-checks.yml (tsc + vitest + smoke render)"}

opportunities.title: Hosted render + shot-preview micro-SaaS
opportunities.thesis: The repo explicitly does not ship a hosted renderer; it documents three headless-Linux wall (concurrency cap, chrome-headless-shell, blocked CDN). A hosted 'render this shot with your product screenshots' API converts a documented pain point into a paid action.

opportunities.title: Paid brand kits (themes, palettes, SFX packs)
opportunities.thesis: The Apache-2.0 core already ships 9 visual themes (template/THEMES.md) and 149 SFX. Selling pre-skins that drop into the same schema is pure margin: the runtime, the cards and the acceptance rules are already paid for by the community.

opportunities.title: 9-locale shot library hub (the site itself)
opportunities.thesis: Upstream ships a library site with exactly two locales and English-only card copy. RU/ES/DE/FR/PT/KO/JA pages for 'product promo video' + 'motion design shot library' intent have almost no competition: the keyword space is English-dominant while the audience is global. Every page is a proof-of-work asset that also serves as a lead magnet.

opportunities.title: Agency: 36-second film in a day
opportunities.thesis: A hands-on third-party run reports 35 minutes hands-on for a 36-second promo, and the template is a validated 36.2s / 10-shot cut. That is a unit-economics story, not a tool story: sell the outcome (a launch film before the funding announcement), not the repo.

cards.intention: 第一拍先给品牌记忆点：观众在任何产品画面出现之前，先看清并记住名字。安静、纸墨质感、有一个完整的静止时刻。

cards.name: crane-rise-reveal
cards.summary_en: The camera starts tight on one data row, rises and pulls back, then reveals a full dashboard filling the frame.
cards.intention: 开场定场库内已有 drone-dive-landing——从上帝视角砸进 hero 特写， "全局→焦点"。本卡是它的镜像："焦点→全局"——先怼在一行真实数据上 让观众看清"这是什么"，再升降臂式拉升后退，一排排内容涌入画面， 最后整面产品铺满——"你看到的这一行，只是这一面墙的一格"。 适合以产品体量/内容丰富度为卖点的开场；两卡同片只用一个方向。
cards.use: "从细节到全局"的开场定场；与 drone-dive-landing（全局→单点俯冲）互为反向
cards.duration_text: 5s（特写 hold 20f + 拉升 100f + 满幅静止 30f）
cards.energy_text: 中高（持续单向运动，无冲击拍）

cards.name: dataviz-landscape-open
cards.summary_en: Streams of light merge across a dark data landscape while labels hover and a shallow-depth camera glides forward.
cards.intention: Linear Releases 发布片开场实证的品牌级开场品类：把产品背后的数据世界 拍成一片**暗场地景**——支流线束从画面深处汇入一条主干（"无数工作流 汇成一个产品"的隐喻），真实感来自三样东西：①虚构 issue/任务 ID 标签 浮在线上（观众认出"这是我每天看到的那种东西"）；②重景深——近景大虚焦 流过、中景标签清晰可读、远景渐隐，三层纵深让平面 SVG 读作空间； ③相机低速匀稳飞越——这是氛围段不是炫技段，速度感交给后面的镜头。 手搓 UI 合规依据：非复刻场景（页面上不存在此画面），按核心理念 1 修订版走质量+表达明确性门槛。
cards.use: 品牌级抽象开场（"数据宇宙"隐喻），接亮场产品段或字标；与 glow-flyline-moves 分工：那卡是段落内卡片之间的连线叙事，本卡是开场专用的全画幅地景
cards.energy_text: 低开缓升（起步位，为后续爬升留空间）

cards.name: fracture
cards.summary_en: Twenty-five 3D tiles fly in from scattered space and lock into a poster in a center-out ripple, hold for a beat, then accelerate outward off-screen in all directions.
cards.intention: 把"产品成形"拍成物理事件：碎片从三维空间各自带着旋转飞回原位，观众看着一面完整画面从无序中长出来；hold 读字后再整体炸出画面，把注意力干净地交给下一镜。进出对称，一支素材可正反两用。
cards.use: 开场第一镜"从混沌到成形"的品牌/海报揭示；倒放或只取后半可作硬转场
cards.energy_text: 高（两头高能、中段静止，适合压 BGM 重音起收）

cards.name: icon-field-colorize
cards.summary_en: A grid of grayscale icons staggers in to fill the screen, holds a beat, then brand-color bands ripple down and light the whole field at once.
cards.intention: 先用灰阶把"多"摆足——上百个小图标错峰浮进来铺满画面，灰阶保证 读作背景纹理不抢戏；停一拍让观众意识到"摆满了"，然后品牌色以 横带波纹形式极快扫过全场，灰世界一瞬间被点亮。命门在**翻色不是 同帧硬翻**：原片实测是 ~0.5s 内多道色波依次向下快扫（蓝先覆盖全场， 橙/绿/红依次覆盖更低行带），终态呈四色横带分层——波纹感让"点亮" 有方向和速度，硬翻只读作换了张图。
cards.use: 开场铺陈产品能力面（图标=功能宇宙）再一举打上品牌色；功能集合页、生态/集成规模展示、片头 logo 前垫场
cards.duration_text: 浮现 ~45f 错峰 + 静置 ~10f + 翻色 12–45f + 终态静置；全段 3–4s
cards.energy_text: 中（浮现是铺垫，翻色瞬间是唯一爆点）

cards.name: letterspace-materialize
cards.summary_en: Every letter of a widely tracked wordmark draws itself in parallel, growing like handwriting and finishing together on the same frame.
cards.intention: 字标不是淡入也不是打字机，而是"结晶"：全部字母的笔画同时 开始连续生长，像一只看不见的手同时写所有字母，同一瞬间齐收 成词。两个命门：**连续**（笔画必须是连续画出的过程，不许遮罩 分段——先半截再另半截会被读穿；任何中间帧都该像"写到一半"）； **同步**（所有字母同帧起笔、同帧完成——逐字错峰是打字机语义， 这里是整词一体的仪式感）。
cards.use: 片尾/片头品牌字标登场（SUPERHUMAN 式大字距全大写）；章节题字；needs 静谧/高级感的收束帧
cards.duration_text: 静置 ~15f + 描画 ~50f + 终态静置 ≥30f；全段 3–4s
cards.energy_text: 低（静谧仪式感，一次呼吸完成）

cards.name: magician-card-flourish
cards.summary_en: A blue starburst flashes on black for a third of a second, then a card shoots out of the flash, spinning along an arc toward camera before freezing near full frame.
cards.intention: 魔术师甩牌：一道蓝色星芒闪过，卡片仿佛从光里被变出来——从画面 中心极远处（视觉上一个小点）弹射而出，沿弧线极速自旋飞向镜头， 到达中心瞬间硬定格成近满幅展示。三个魔术感命门：**闪光先行** （光是"变"的仪式，0.3s 短促干脆）、**弹射节奏**（起飞慢速蓄力→ 急加速踢出→弧线段减速抵达，slow-in→burst→decelerating arc）、 **定格即静**（无减速尾巴无回弹，13 整圈自旋保证定格恰为正面）。
cards.use: 单张卡片/海报/封面的魔术性登场（片头主视觉、产品卡揭晓）；纯黑暗场；需要"变出来"仪式感的爆点
cards.duration_text: 闪光 0.3s + 飞行 ~1.7s + 定格展示+扫光 ~2s；全段 4.2s
cards.energy_text: 高（一次性爆点，定格后即静）

cards.name: orbit-ring-title-open
cards.summary_en: Eight 16:9 content cards orbit an ellipse at a constant rate with their contents frozen on the first frame, then all start playing together while the centred headline de-blurs into place and a marker block sweeps across the key phrase.
cards.intention: 开场想说"我们有一整套东西"，最常见的做法是把截图排成网格——但网格是静止的，观众 读到的是"一堆图片"，不是"一套会动的产品"。这张卡把陈列改成**环形巡回**：八张卡沿 椭圆匀速公转，永远有卡在进画、有卡在出画，画面自带"还有更多"的暗示，而标题稳稳 钉在正中间不受影响。 关键的取舍是**卡内容要真的在播**。静态截图上环，观众只会认出"轮播图"；卡里跑着真 动效，同一个环立刻变成"产品在工作"。但八张卡同时开播会八个动效抢戏，谁也读不进去 ——所以入场期把卡内容**冻结在首帧**，等环撑开、标题起手之后再统一开播。观众的注意 力顺序因此是：先认出这是一圈产品画面 → 读标题 → 才注意到卡里都在动。
cards.use: 开场第一镜 = 「这个产品有一整套东西」；素材库/模板库/功能矩阵/案例集的门面拍；需要用真实运动的产品画面托住一句主张，而不是把截图摆成静态九宫格
cards.duration_text: 约 4.3s（130f@30fps；标题落定 f50 到退场 f108 之间是 1.9s 稳态巡回）
cards.energy_text: 中（唯一的持续运动是匀速公转，全片只有马克块横扫一次冲击）

cards.name: spotlight-hero-card
cards.summary_en: A spotlight selects one card, the camera pushes diagonally, the card lifts for two outline passes, then returns to the page.
cards.intention: 开场只讲一件事：这一张卡就是产品的原子单位。聚光灯替观众做视线引导，弹起悬浮给它体积和重量，轮廓光束是"扫描/检视"的隐喻，最后贴回原位表示它属于这个页面。
cards.use: "单一主角"式产品开场；把一个核心对象（卡片/条目/模块）立成全片主角
cards.energy_text: 中（质感最高的一镜，节奏慢而稳）

cards.name: stroke-segment-build
cards.summary_en: Disconnected title strokes illuminate in a scrambled order and become readable only when the final segments snap into place.
cards.intention: 《异形》片头判例：标题不是被画出来的，是"显影"出来的——拆成离散 笔画段乱序点亮，观众前 70% 时间只看到神秘碎段，最后几段落位的瞬间 突然读出是什么字。"认出的那一刻"就是钩子，钩子的强度取决于 不可读期撑多久、钥匙段压多晚。
cards.use: 开场吊悬念的产品名/大数字揭晓；一支片 ≤1 次；与 type-assembly/draw-svg-trace 分工：那些是"看着字被组装/描画"，本卡是"意义延迟揭晓"
cards.energy_text: 低起中收（悬念型，落位帧是能量点）

cards.name: text-as-mask
cards.summary_en: Product footage moves inside oversized title letters before the type expands until the footage takes over the frame.
cards.intention: 标题和产品画面抢屏幕是老问题——先字后画慢，画上压字挤。这一式让 两者同体：字形就是遮罩，产品只透过笔画显形，观众同时读到词和画面 质感；结尾字形胀开溢出画幅，产品自然接管全屏——"从品牌词走进产品" 一条镜头说完，兼任章节转场（与 transition-travel C 字腔穿越同族： 那边是镜头钻进字腔，这边是字形自己胀开，前者相机动、后者门动）。
cards.use: 品牌词/口号与产品画面二合一的开场或章节卡；字是门、产品在门里
cards.duration_text: 5s（hold 20f + 字内漂移 80f + 放大接管 30f + 静止 20f）
cards.energy_text: 中高（漂移段沉稳，接管段一次爆发）

cards.name: blur-slide
cards.summary_en: Title words rise into place one after another as vertical offset, blur, and opacity converge on a single shared ease, with the subtitle following before the title settles.
cards.intention: 这是文字 reveal 的**默认解**——没有奇观、没有机械感，只是把词一个个 柔和地放到位。它的专业感全来自一件事：y、blur、opacity 三个通道共用 同一个进度 `p`、同一条缓动，所以词是"从虚焦里浮出来"而不是"滑进来 顺便淡一下"。当一支片里已经有别的重手法（乱码/翻牌/滚轮），标题就该 用这一卡，让位给主角。
cards.use: 几乎所有标题/副标题成对出现的场合；产品页首屏文案、章节小标题；需要"专业但不抢戏"的默认文字 reveal
cards.energy_text: 低（一次性收敛，无峰值无循环）

cards.name: brace-expand
cards.summary_en: A tight pair of braces appears at center, then springs apart and scales up to title size, revealing the text through a clip width bound strictly to the brace gap.
cards.intention: 标题揭示的手法里，本卡最省：不做遮罩条、不做逐字、不做位移——只让 一对括号往两边走，文字被"括出来"。它天生带代码语感（`{}` 是花括号）， 所以在技术产品语境里读作"这就是内容本体"。命门是 clip 宽度**必须严格 绑括号位置**：一旦文字自己淡入或自己擦入，括号就退化成装饰，幕布感全失。
cards.use: 开发者/技术产品的标题字卡；章节开场；需要"一个符号完成揭示"的极简一拍
cards.duration_text: 约 3.8s（114f@30fps：7f 出现 → 弹开 → 落定后字距松弛 → hold）
cards.energy_text: 中（单次过冲是唯一峰值，其余静止）

cards.name: cel-flash-stomp
cards.summary_en: Large words stamp into frame on the beat while flat background colors flash behind the locked typography.
cards.intention: 逐词砸字（stomp typography）单用只有重量；背景纯色闪（动漫背景 フラッシュ——必杀技名出现时底色交替闪）单用只是闪。焊在一起互补 成立：词砸下的落定帧正是底闪的起爆帧，**主体稳、背景闪**——观众 盯着字，眼角余光里整个世界在震颤，打击感来自周边视野而不来自主体 抖动。这是与震屏完全相反的路线：震屏晃主体，本卡晃世界。三词逐拍 递进，末词闪加倍+标签条收束，一句口号剪成三记盖章。
cards.use: 口号/三连词的高能段落（"SHIP / FASTER / TODAY"式）；文字节奏卡，与 type-rhythm-sync 互补（那是字属性动，这是字砸+底闪）
cards.duration_text: 每词 ~30f × 词数 + 收尾 ≥45f；三词约 4.8s
cards.energy_text: 高

cards.name: countdown-arc-scatter
cards.summary_en: Numbers arranged tangentially along a large arc sweep past and brake to a stop, the winning digit sliding out of the dial to become the first character of the headline.
cards.intention: "5 分钟装完"写成静态字卡没人信。表盘扫过的做法把这个数字放进一个 **量程**里：45、35、28、22、17、10 一路扫过去，停在 5——观众看到的是 "从很多降到很少"，数字自带论证。停下后 "5" 不消失而是**平移变成标题的 首字符**，一个元素完成从仪表到文案的身份切换，这是本卡最值钱的一手。
cards.use: 倒计时/时长承诺类文案（"5 min to install"）；数据揭晓的一拍；需要"仪表盘"语汇的浅底短镜
cards.energy_text: 高（96° 大幅扫动压进 17 帧，纯冲击）

cards.name: document-typewriter-reveal
cards.summary_en: A fully typeset document writes itself behind one accent-color caret, opens both side columns, and drops history entries into the rail.
cards.intention: 观众会读清屏幕上每个字——这一镜的说服力全在"文档是真的"。打字机式写入把静态页面变成"正在被写出来的文档"，侧栏历史条目落入补上"持续产出"的时间纵深。
cards.use: 文档/报告/笔记类功能镜头；信息密度最高的一拍
cards.energy_text: 低中（信息密度最高，节奏放稳让观众读字）

cards.name: flying-words
cards.summary_en: Keywords spawn deep in a perspective tunnel and rush past the camera along the z axis, fading in and out on a lifecycle curve across two seamless loops.
cards.intention: 关键词列举最土的做法是堆一屏静态词云。词语隧道把同一批词**摊到时间轴上**： 远处生成、由小变大、擦过镜头消失，观众永远只在读三五个词，但主观感受是 "词很多"。它是背景层不是主角层——相机不动、元素动，所以前景压一层标题 或 UI 完全不打架。词表整体替换成项目关键词即可，不改一行运动逻辑。
cards.use: 关键词云/能力清单的动态背景；片头片尾的"信息量"垫底层；需要纵深穿越感的转场
cards.duration_text: 约 6.0s（180f@30fps，2 个完整循环，可无缝接续）
cards.energy_text: 高（全屏持续 3D 位移，画面无一刻静止）

cards.name: glitch-cycle
cards.summary_en: Status phrases cycle through one monospace slot, each dissolving into noise at both ends with RGB split and jitter, while a progress bar tracks the whole run.
cards.intention: 状态播报最笨的做法是四行字逐条淡入。轮播把它们压进**一个槽位**： 短语头尾用乱码"熔断"再"凝固"，中段几乎干净只偶尔抽一下——观众读到的 是"系统在一步步推进"，而不是四条独立文案。乱码浓度是这卡的语法： 浓 = 正在切换，淡 = 正在这一状态里。底部进度条把四拍串成一条时间线， 最后一条把概率收到 0，落定即结束。
cards.use: 加载/构建/部署过程的状态播报；技术型片头的"系统自述"；需要机器口吻推进时间的一段垫底
cards.energy_text: 中高（持续的高频噪声脉冲，切换点是峰值）

cards.name: gradient-word-sweep
cards.summary_en: A gradient light sweeps left to right across a keyword, charging each character with glow that decays behind the wavefront until the whole word breathes.
cards.intention: 整句白字里只有关键词被"通电"：渐变彩光从左到右快速扫过字符， 像能量注入——扫过的瞬间最亮（波前尾迹），随后衰减到稳态； 填满后字符之间跳起勾连的细闪电，词保持泛光呼吸。三个命门： **快**（扫充 15–20f，慢了读作进度条）、**波前最亮**（刚点亮的 字符效果最强，没有这个梯度就是静态渐变裁切）、**辉光克制** （AE 式多层泛光但别糊成一团，闪电细而稀疏才是点缀）。
cards.use: 标语里给单个动词/卖点词充能（Supercharged/faster/AI…）；能量高潮段的文字戏；黑场品牌片的口号帧
cards.duration_text: 扫充 ~15–20f（要快）+ 稳态闪电呼吸 1–2s；全段 2.5–3.5s
cards.energy_text: 高（一词爆点，前后都该让位）

cards.name: lead-word-zoom-assemble
cards.summary_en: The lead word fills the frame at 2.3x and keeps drifting toward the viewer, then a single curve recedes it to size while the line slides left and the trailing words are pushed into their slots — pivoting on the lead word centre and the measured baseline.
cards.intention: 字卡最容易犯的错是"整句一起淡入"——观众同时收到 5 个词，一个都没记住。这张卡把 阅读顺序做成**物理顺序**：先只给一个词，而且大到占满画面、还在继续朝观众推近，观众 被迫先读它；然后这个词退回自己在句子里的尺寸和位置，整句围绕它长出来。落定时观众 已经读过两遍主词。 真正的手感命门不是缩放曲线，而是**支点**。首词从"画面正中"走到"行内第三个字符的 位置"，如果支点取行盒中心，缩放和左滑会各自把字往两边拽，末尾几帧基线抖得肉眼可见。 把 `transform-origin` 横向钉在首词中心、纵向钉在基线，这两点全程不动，整行就只是 "收小"，没有任何漂移。
cards.use: 品牌名/产品名的 Introducing 字卡；发布会式开场第二镜；一句话主张需要"先让一个词占满画面、再把整句补齐"的场合
cards.duration_text: 约 2.8s（84f@30fps；组句 f32 完成、上移与副行 f34–50、静止 22f、末 12f crash）
cards.energy_text: 中高（起手就是满画面的大字，但全程只有一次运动，没有二次冲击）

cards.name: marker-underline-title
cards.summary_en: After the headline settles, a marker stroke draws itself under the keyword — tapered, rough-edged, and slightly tilted to follow the italic.
cards.intention: 打印体标题里突然出现一笔手绘马克笔，用材质反差把一个词从 排版里拎出来——像人拿笔在海报上圈重点。命门有三：**快** （8–12f 一笔呵成，慢了读作加载条）、**近**（贴着字底，离远了 读作分隔线不是强调）、**跟字势**（斜体词的划线必须左低右高 微上斜——斜向画反是最容易犯且一眼假的错，判例见已知坑）。
cards.use: 标题里强调单个关键词（new/free/AI…）；手写感/人味的品牌调性；正文标注式强调
cards.duration_text: 标题落定 +4~8f 后起笔，划线 8–12f，总 1–1.5s
cards.energy_text: 低（一笔点睛，不抢标题的戏）

cards.name: outline-word-fill
cards.summary_en: An outlined word snaps down from triple size while a dashed circle and horizontal guides close in, then the stroke flips to solid white in a single frame with one brief glow.
cards.intention: 一个词要打成钉子，靠的不是慢慢淡入而是**两次落定**：先是巨大空心字 急速收缩到位（这是尺寸的落定），再是描边在一帧内变实心白（这是质感的 落定）。中间那 1.5s 的虚线圆收缩与水平虚线内伸是"瞄准"过程——技术 制图语汇，让点亮那一下读作"确认"。填充**必须是瞬时**的：慢扫填充会把 钉子变成缓慢的美化动画。
cards.use: 单词式利益点/口号的重锤一拍；节奏卡点上的"钉子"镜；深底品牌片的强调帧
cards.energy_text: 高（3.2 倍收缩 + 瞬时点亮，短时高冲击）

cards.name: paper-title-card
cards.summary_en: A sentence stamps onto paper word by word, highlights one amber italic term, and closes with a short rule.
cards.intention: 在两段产品画面之间给观众一句话的喘息：说清"接下来看什么、它值什么"。letterpress 压印质感让字卡与纸墨风格的产品画面同属一个世界。
cards.use: 章节转场/价值主张字卡；重要功能出场前的引导卡；全片呼吸位
cards.energy_text: 低（呼吸位，隔开两段高能镜头）

cards.name: pill-chip-slot-cycle-handled
cards.summary_en: A dark chip inside the sentence rolls through feature words, its width easing to each word so the surrounding text is pushed apart while grey ghost items show above and below.
cards.intention: 词槽轮换有两派：让句子躲开变化（宽度固定的滚轮），或者让句子**接受** 变化（胶囊撑宽、两侧文字被挤开）。这卡是后者，代价是必须把宽度算准， 回报是句子读起来活的——"Your" 和 "Handled" 被推着走，观众感到胶囊里 的词有分量。上下露出的灰色幽灵项是第二个记号：它明示"这是个可以滚的 列表"，让观众预期还有下一个词。
cards.use: "我们替你搞定 ___" 这类句式卖点；SaaS 功能列举的一句话收口；浅底品牌片主视觉一拍
cards.energy_text: 中（三拍稳定节拍，宽度伸缩是唯一的连续运动）

cards.name: pill-slot-cycle
cards.summary_en: A fixed sentence keeps its trailing pill slot spinning like a slot machine through feature words until the final word locks the sentence.
cards.intention: 罗列六个功能，列表要六行、逐条淡入要六拍还占满屏。词槽轮换把它们 塞进**一句话的一个槽位**里：句干 "One AI tool to ___" 是承诺，槽里 滚过的每个 pill 是证据，最后 pill 飞走、"do it all." 落位——证据 列举完毕，结论盖章。结构自带三幕：承诺→列举→收束。命门是句干 **纹丝不动**：观众的眼睛全程钉在槽位上，句干一晃列举感就散。
cards.use: "功能列举"类文案的最优雅解法（比逐条列表快、比乱码解码有语义）；一句话卖点 + 多个动词短语的段落
cards.duration_text: 入场 12f + 每拍 21f × 词数 + 收束 14f + hold；6 词约 5.8s（demo 175f）
cards.energy_text: 中（稳定节拍器，无峰值）

cards.name: scramble
cards.summary_en: Every character flickers through a seeded symbol pool two frames at a time, then locks to its real glyph left to right, each lock flashing a short blue-white glow.
cards.intention: 同一句标题的三种"造字"手法里，打字机是人在写、翻牌是机器在播报， 乱码锁定是**机器在算**——先满屏噪声表示"还没解出来"，再左→右一个个 咬定真字符。它天然带黑客/解密腔，适合技术产品的开场；但也最挑文案： 字符是被逐个点名的，字数就是节拍数。
cards.use: 技术型开场标题；版本号/代号揭晓；"系统就绪""数据解锁"这类带机器口吻的一拍
cards.energy_text: 中高（持续高频跳字的视觉噪声，无单点冲击）

cards.name: split-flap-title
cards.summary_en: Characters flip through two incorrect glyphs before locking into the title in a left-to-right mechanical wave.
cards.intention: 文字三式的第三式：压印（paper-title-card）是纸上落墨的"低语"，打字机 （document-typewriter-reveal）是文档被人写出来的"叙述"，翻牌是车站大屏的 "播报"——带机械宣告腔。选翻牌的语境：倒计时/发车感（版本发布、截止日）、 数据播报感（指标揭晓）、或想给标题一层复古机械质感。它天然是等宽深底 格子，在库内纸墨审美里读作"纸面上摆了一块机械显示屏"——异色块本身 就是看点，背景产品画面压暗降饱和给它让位。
cards.use: 开场/章节大标题；倒计时、发布日期、数据播报类文案；需要"机械宣告感"的一拍
cards.duration_text: 约 4.7s（140f：≥20f 乱码静止建立 + 级联翻牌 + ≥15f 停定静止）
cards.energy_text: 中（持续的机械动感，非瞬时冲击）

cards.name: text-column-converge
cards.summary_en: Two words pinned at opposite screen edges hard-swap through options, then slide together exactly once to lock into the final phrase.
cards.intention: 两词分踞左右像目录页对峙，观众以为只是轮换字幕；直到最后一词 停稳才发现左右其实是同一句话的两半——唯一一次连续合拢把整段 轮换追认为"悬念铺垫"。命门是**钉死**：轮换期两词位置一像素不动、 左右屏边距完全相等（原片实测 412 vs 413@1280），任何渐进收缩都会 提前剧透合拢、把揭晓稀释成进度条。合拢只许发生一次，且必须在 最后一词之后——这是收尾揭晓，不是持续动效。
cards.use: 特性清单收束到产品名/口号的段落（"NEW × 一串特性 → NEW <产品名>"式）；发布会式 recap、版本号揭晓
cards.duration_text: 轮换 7–16f/词 × 8–9 词 + 合拢 ~36f + 小字后静置；全段约 5–6s
cards.energy_text: 中低（机器节奏、小字规格清单气质，不是砸字）

cards.name: title-demote-to-label
cards.summary_en: A centered headline stands for a beat, then shrinks and slides to the top-left corner to become a section label as content grows beneath it.
cards.intention: 章节标题的常规命运是"出现→消失→内容登场"，标题和内容互不认识。 本卡让标题**降格而不退场**：居中大字站稳一拍宣告主题，然后一次连续 补间缩到 0.3x 飞到左上角，落成这一节的栏目标签——它还在屏幕上， 只是从主角变成了门牌。观众获得免费的空间记忆：刚才那个大词就是 现在左上角那个小词，本节讲的就是它。内容骨架在降格进行中就开始 生长，交接零空档。
cards.use: 章节开场（标题先当主角再让位给内容）；教程/功能演示片的小节交接；B 式给"文字/编辑"类产品加身份暗示
cards.energy_text: 低中（版式变换型，氛围镜头）

cards.name: type-assembly-moves
cards.summary_en: Four typography assemblies: split-letter rise, drifting convergence, tracking expansion, and text flowing along a path.
cards.intention: 标题入场已有"原位变形系"四式（乱码解码/字符坠落/翻牌/打字机——字 在原地换形态）。本卡补"集结系"：字符从别处**汇聚成**标题，运动轨迹 本身有戏。A 琴键式——每字从看不见的裁切线下滑升，理性利落，通用度 最高；B 片头式——字符四散带模糊漂入、逐个锁定加深，Stranger Things 的仪式感，适合品牌名亮相;C 呼吸式——字母从叠压一团吸一口气展开， 最安静的一式，适合抒情段落；D 语义式——字符沿一条上升曲线鱼贯流入 再摆正，曲线可以正好描着图表增长线走，文字与数据同框叙事。
cards.use: 大标题/标语的入场；与 type-entrance-moves 两式、split-flap-title、document-typewriter-reveal 同属标题入场大品类，全片 ≤2 种
cards.duration_text: 单式 4–5s（动作段 A ~56f / B ~104f / C ~58f / D ~99f，均含 hold）
cards.energy: A 中 / B 中高 / C 低中 / D 中
cards.energy_text: A 中 / B 中高 / C 低中 / D 中

cards.name: type-entrance-moves
cards.summary_en: Two title entrances: characters decoding from noise and letters falling under gravity before bouncing into alignment.
cards.intention: 标题入场库内已有打字机（沉稳文档感）和翻牌屏（机械仪式感），这两式补 另外两种性格：A 是终端黑客感——字符先是一片高速噪声，从左到右逐个 "解码"锁定，观众看着答案从乱码里长出来，适合技术产品的自信亮相； B 是物理喜剧感——字符从天而降、砸地弹跳、歪歪扭扭站定，最后一拍 集体立正归位，适合轻松调性的开场破冰。四种标题入场同片 ≤2 种（P4）。
cards.use: 大标题/章节字卡的入场；与 split-flap-title（机械翻牌）、document-typewriter-reveal（打字机）同品类互斥选用
cards.duration_text: 单式 4–5s（含 hold 与静止收尾；动作段 A ~66f / B ~106f）
cards.energy_text: 中高（A 偏理性推进，B 偏物理趣味）

cards.name: type-rhythm-sync
cards.summary_en: Two voice-and-beat synchronizations: font weight pulsing on percussion and spoken words filling like karaoke.
cards.intention: 文字动效库内此前全是"入场怎么进"，没有词管"在场的字怎么跟着声音活"。 这两式补上：A 让标题变成节奏器官——笔画随低音鼓抽动变粗又弹回， 文字在蹦迪，适合高能段落的视觉低音炮；B 让标语变成跟读字幕—— 旁白读到哪个词哪个词从左到右填色点亮，视线被牵着走，适合口播/ 标语强调段。共同点是**字不动、属性动**：无位移、无入退场， 纯粹是字重/颜色在声音的拍点上呼吸。
cards.use: 标题/标语与音轨强绑定的段落；A 绑节拍（鼓点），B 绑语音（旁白逐词）
cards.duration_text: 单式 4–5s；A 每拍占 10f 衰减窗、B 每词按语速 15–35f
cards.energy_text: A 高（蹦迪感）/ B 中（跟读引导）

cards.name: typewriter-moves
cards.summary_en: Two typing narratives: a terminal command that triggers the scene and a three-act mistake, deletion, and retype.
cards.intention: 打字是唯一自带时间性的文字入场——字符一个个到来本身就是节奏， 不需要额外动效。A 把打字当**引信**：暗色终端窗逐字敲出命令、 方块光标方波闪，回车帧镜头急推进命令行硬切产品界面，命令行是 场景的导火索，开发者产品标配；B 把打字当**独白**：逐字打出平庸词 （"just a dashboard"）→ 停顿犹豫 → 退格删掉 → 更快打出卖点词 （"your command center"），犹豫-否定-宣言的三幕剧，戏全在三档 速度差里。与 scramble-decode 的区别：乱码解码是机器在猜， 打字是人在说。
cards.use: 开发者产品开场（A）、slogan/卖点字卡（B）；文字自带时间性的入场
cards.energy: A 中高 / B 中低
cards.energy_text: A 中高 / B 中低

cards.name: typing-code-block
cards.summary_en: The same syntax-highlighted snippet reveals two ways side by side: lines fade up on a stagger on the left, characters type out in full token color on the right.
cards.intention: 代码揭示只有两种真解法：**整行浮出来**（读的是结构）和**一个字一个字打** （读的是过程）。这卡把两者并排放在同一段代码上，是选型用的对照镜： 左侧 4 行 4 拍就完，适合"代码不是重点、结果才是"；右侧 138 帧才打完 59 个字符，适合"看我写"。关键细节是右侧**打字不丢色**——常见错误是 打字时先出白字再着色，那就退化成终端回显，不是代码编辑器。
cards.use: 代码/配置揭示镜头；开发者产品的"就三行"演示；需要对比两种揭示节奏时的选型参考镜
cards.energy_text: 中（右侧持续打字推进，左侧一次性收敛）

cards.name: vertical-word-roll-blur-cycle
cards.summary_en: The closing word of a tagline rolls vertically through a three-line reel, neighbouring rows blurring into grey depth while the settled word takes the accent color.
cards.intention: 句尾换词的最优解是滚轮而不是淡入淡出：滚轮自带**方向**（往上翻页）， 观众知道"还有下一个"。这卡的两个身份记号是相邻行的**垂直 blur** （滚轮景深，模拟机械转筒的失焦）和落定时的**染色**（灰→强调色， "这个才是答案"）。句干 `Built for` 全程纹丝不动——眼睛钉在滚轮上， 句干一晃列举感就散。
cards.use: "Built for ___" 这类句干 + 受众/对象列举的一句话卖点；浅底品牌片的干净一拍
cards.duration_text: 约 5.0s（150f@30fps：静置 → 3 次换词 → 尾部整组淡出）
cards.energy_text: 中（稳定三拍，无峰值）

cards.name: word-relay-filmstrip
cards.summary_en: A filmstrip of page cards steps vertically while a serif word relay swaps only its verb, each swap aligned to the center of the current card.
cards.intention: 左边是证据（页面截图胶片），右边是论点（大词）：动词换一次， 胶片就步进一格给出新证据——文字与画面互为注脚。命门是**步进制**： 左列平时完全静止，只在切词瞬间滚动一格（滚动=换证据的机械动作）， 持续滚动会让左列沦为背景装饰、切词失去"咔哒"感。第二命门是 **对齐**：大词块垂直中心必须与当前页面卡中点精确对齐（像素级）， 歪了整个版式的"编辑部严谨感"就塌了。
cards.use: "一个主体 × 多种能力"的枚举段（Computer researches/builds/codes…）；作品集/案例流展示；产品多场景巡礼
cards.energy_text: 中低（编辑部气质，节奏靠切词的"咔哒"感）

cards.name: word-relay-geometry
cards.summary_en: Three benefit words hand off in turn, each with its own geometry — a spinning dashed circle, three interlocking circles that trim into view, and a metallic sheen that resolves to pure white.
cards.intention: 三点式利益陈述最容易做成三张字卡硬切。接力的做法是给每个词配一套 **只属于它的几何**：虚线圆是"在转"（快）、三圆相扣是"互相咬合"（好）、 金属扫光是"材质硬"（强）——几何本身就在替形容词做论证。第三个词 留了升格待遇（sheen 扫光 + 收白），因为它是结论。背景 20 颗微尘上浮 把三拍缝成一个连续空间，不然还是三张卡。
cards.use: 三点式利益陈述（更快/更好/更强）；品牌价值观段落；需要"一词一世界"的中段推进
cards.duration_text: 约 6.0s（180f@30fps：三段各 0.36 时长窗，段间重叠 0.04）
cards.energy_text: 中高（三拍推进 + 全程几何运动 + 背景粒子，无静止帧）

cards.name: avatar-bracket-carousel
cards.summary_en: A four-corner focus bracket stays locked mid-sentence while a vertical queue of avatars springs through it three times, each one sharpening and growing as it enters the frame and shrinking, dimming and blurring as it leaves.
cards.intention: "我们有设计师、客服、分析师、写手"列成四行就是一张清单。塞进一句话的一个槽位里， 它变成一个承诺加四次证明：句子不动，只有槽里的人在换。四角对焦框是这个手法的关键 ——它不参与轮换，但它把观众的眼睛钉死在那 92×92 的方框里，所以四次更换才读作 "同一个位置"而不是"四张头像飘过"。
cards.use: "一个位置，多种角色"的能力枚举；团队/身份/预设/人格类产品的核心一句话镜头
cards.energy_text: 中（三次等距切换构成稳定节拍器，对焦框脉冲是唯一装饰性动作）

cards.name: bezier-source-converge-merge
cards.summary_en: Four source nodes each draw a thin bezier curve toward one convergence point, then slide along their own curve and shrink as if swallowed, while accent data packets glide the paths and the curves erase backward.
cards.intention: "我们把四个来源统一了"是一句抽象话。这个动效把它变成可看的物理过程：先建立四条独立 的通路（draw-on 是"连上了"），再让四个来源真的顺着通路走进同一个点并被吸进去（缩小 到 0 是"被吞并"），最后擦掉通路只留徽标（"现在只有一个"）。三段叙事各自有明确的 起止，观众不需要旁白就能读出因果。
cards.use: "多源整合/统一接入/数据汇聚"的核心机制镜头；集成、聚合、单一入口类产品的说明段落
cards.energy_text: 中（长镜慢速推进，靠数据包滑行维持活性；吞并瞬间是唯一小高点）

cards.name: card-stack
cards.summary_en: Eight cards spring up from below the frame one after another and pile into a single stack, then the whole pile fans out into a 3D arc as each card rotates, slides sideways and steps back in depth.
cards.intention: 一摞卡先聚成一个物体，再摊开成一组物体——顺序很关键：先给"整体"再给"个体"。 观众第一眼记住的是有分量的一摞（数量感），第二眼才看清每张不一样（多样性）。 展开动作留到最后一次性完成，是为了不和入场的节拍打架。
cards.use: 需要交代"我们有一组东西"的产品段落；卡片墙/模板库/方案列表的建立镜头，也能当 logo 前的一拍蓄势
cards.energy_text: 中高（入场是连续小爆发，展开段收成一次平滑的整体动作）

cards.name: carousel-3d
cards.summary_en: Eight cards sit on a circular ring laid out with sin and cos, spinning through exactly one full revolution while each card billboards outward with matched front and back faces so it never reads as mirrored or upside down.
cards.intention: 展示"一组东西"最省事的办法是排成一排横滑，但横滑有起点和终点。环形没有——它天然 循环，观众看多久都不会觉得"放完了"。这张卡真正要解决的是环形 carousel 最容易翻车 的点：卡片背面。方案是双面同向贴图，所以从环内看和从环外看是同一张正立的卡，环转一圈 不会有任何一帧出现镜像或倒置。
cards.use: 作品集/模板库/集成清单的循环展示；需要无缝 loop 的背景拍或落地页 hero
cards.energy_text: 中（匀速无变化，是可无限循环的稳态运动）

cards.name: cloner-depth-echo
cards.summary_en: A card duplicates into a diagonal depth trail, holds briefly, then accelerates back into one springy original.
cards.intention: Spline/C4D Cloner 语汇的 UI 翻译：一张主卡"啪"地复印出 7 个克隆体 沿 Z 轴向后等距排开（间隔 120px、透明度 100%→20% 递减），错峰弹出 成纵队；停 ~25f 让观众数得清"有很多个"；然后全体 ease-in 加速吸回 本体合一，合体瞬间本体弹 1.08x 收束。与 depth-layer-moves 视差 （不同内容分层）分工：这是**同一内容**的等距重影阵列，语义是规模 不是空间。
cards.use: "多副本/多租户/规模感/批量处理"卖点；一镜讲完"一个=很多"
cards.energy_text: 中（陈列-收束型）

cards.name: deck-deal-flyin
cards.summary_en: A physical card stack opens the scene, then cards accelerate into a live grid as the camera follows the growing page.
cards.intention: 先给悬念（这一摞是什么？），再给答案（是几十个项目，它们自己飞进页面各就各位）。观众要感受到"东西源源不断地涌进来"，每张卡带着急迫感砸到位。
cards.use: 展示"内容量大/源源不断汇入"的列表页与卡片墙；建立信息密度的第一印象
cards.duration_text: 约 2.6s 发牌段（36–113f），前接约 2s（62f）牌堆特写可选
cards.energy_text: 高（节奏爬升段主力，不放开场第一镜）

cards.name: doc-park-left-pill-deal
cards.summary_en: The source document slides left until only a sliver remains and keeps scrolling slowly, while three outlined pills are dealt one at a time, each followed by a caption that darkens word by word.
cards.intention: 结论要一条一条给，观众才记得住。但如果把来源文档淡出，结论就变成了空中楼阁——观众 不知道这些话从哪来。这张卡的解法是**让来源留在画面里**：文档靠左驻留只露一截，还在 缓慢滚动（说明它正在被读），右侧的每条结论都是从这份文档里长出来的。发牌节奏刻意慢， 是为了给旁白留出说完一句的时间。
cards.use: 旁白驱动的"分析结论逐条给出"段落；文档理解、推荐理由、审阅意见类产品的核心说明镜头
cards.energy_text: 低（慢发牌节奏，全片无峰值；靠自动滚动维持活性）

cards.name: draw-svg-trace
cards.summary_en: An ink stroke traces an element outline, closes with a dark flash, and hands focus to the revealed content.
cards.intention: "画出来"是纸墨审美里最顺手的入场隐喻：元素不是飞进来也不是淡进来， 而是被一支看不见的笔当场描出来。库内 wall-reveal-moves C 式已有整页 蓝图版（全屏线框逐段画+区域点亮），本卡是它的**元素级特写版**—— 一条线、一个主体、一次闭合，笔头可见、方向可读，适合"接下来讲它" 的点名时刻。第二用法是标题下划线生长：同一套路 18f 短版，给重点词 一笔手绘强调，与马克笔审美 token 天然同族。
cards.use: 单个卡片/图表/标题的被点名入场；元素级手法（整页级蓝图描线归 wall-reveal-moves C 式）
cards.duration_text: 描边 40f + 闪黑交棒 16f + hold ≥35f，约 3–4s
cards.energy_text: 中

cards.name: element-body-moves
cards.summary_en: Two ways to give interface elements physicality: elastic axial stretch and a contact shadow that separates during lift.
cards.intention: 库内运动卡全在管"位置在变"——飞入、滑动、弹跳，元素本身始终是刚体。 这两式管**身体在变**：A 给速度一个可见的肉身——飞得越快沿运动轴拉得 越长，一块糖稀，落点压扁回弹收正，squash & stretch 的 UI 翻译；B 给 悬浮一个可信的证据——卡抬起时正下方阴影同步放大变淡，纸片离桌， staging 法则给 2.5D 运镜垫的物理台词。与 smear-multiples 的区别：那是 可数残像（离散鬼影），A 是连续拉伸（糖稀不断丝）；与 CameraMotionBlur 的区别：快门拖影是相机的事，拉伸是身体的事，同一元素别叠加。
cards.use: 给"位置在变"之外补"身体在变"：高速飞入给速度肉身（A）、卡片点名给悬浮证据（B）；A 配横冲入场，B 配 2.5D 运镜与逐张点名
cards.energy: A 中高 / B 低中
cards.energy_text: A 中高 / B 低中

cards.name: floating-glossy-label-pills
cards.summary_en: Four wireframe dashboard panels topped with glossy pills queue up horizontally and step right in three beats, the centered one scaling up sharp while its neighbours shrink, sink and blur at the frame edges.
cards.intention: 四个功能挨个全屏展示会切四刀，观众每次都要重新定位。走廊式 carousel 只有一个视觉 中心：居中的那块是主角，左右各露一截邻居的边缘告诉观众"还有更多、这是同一条队列"。 末段的光标是刻意的：它把叙事从"系统在自动播放"交回"这是一个人在操作"，为下一拍的 交互镜头做交接。
cards.use: 多功能横向枚举（Feature A–D 各一屏）；产品概览、功能巡览类段落，也可作落地页 hero 的循环底
cards.energy_text: 中（三拍换位构成节拍，无爆点；光标是收尾的注意力交接）

cards.name: integration-hub-map
cards.summary_en: A page flips 180 degrees into an integration hub where five app icons pop in together and rainbow light tubes connect with pulses flowing through them.
cards.intention: 翻面是"换时代"：旧文档页整个翻转 180° 得到新中枢页——必须是 完整翻面不是转个角度（判例），翻的动作**快翻+尾段减速**、一口气 完成无分段停顿（"匀速"判例：用户说的匀速=无停顿，不是字面 linear；90° 侧棱停顿版被裁）。侧棱时刻只"闪一下"（1–3f 脉冲， 长光晕平台被裁）。接入是**两拍制**：五图标同帧弹现（第一拍）→ 五管同帧起画齐连（第二拍）——齐，才读作"生态一次到位"；错峰 逐个连读作逐个谈判（两轮被裁）。连通后光管内亮脉冲沿图标→中枢 方向持续循环，"输送感"是终态的生命。
cards.use: 集成/生态能力段（一个产品连一切）；版本翻新叙事（旧页翻成新页）；暗场霓虹调性的功能高潮
cards.duration_text: 前摇 ~0.5s + 快翻 ~1.2s + 图标齐现 → 光管齐连两拍 ~0.7s + 输送呼吸 ≥1.5s；全段 4.5–5s
cards.energy_text: 中高（翻面是爆点，输送段是余韵）

cards.name: list-reveal
cards.summary_en: Menu rows scale into place one after another with a faint overshoot while the whole list drifts slowly upward, keeping the per-item entrance and the group motion on two independent layers.
cards.intention: 列表逐项淡入是最容易做得死板的一类动效：每项动完就停，画面在两项之间是完全静止的。 这张卡的解法是给容器加一层与逐项入场无关的慢速漂移——局部在"找位"，整体在"呼吸"。 观众读得清每一项，同时画面从头到尾没有一帧是钉死的。
cards.use: 导航/侧边栏/设置面板的入场；任何"界面自己长出来"的 UI 段落，也适合做旁白铺垫时的低能量底
cards.energy_text: 低（稳定节拍，无峰值；靠漂移维持画面不死）

cards.name: list-stack-press
cards.summary_en: List cards fly up from below, compress the growing stack on every landing, and advance a synchronized counter.
cards.intention: "堆叠有重量"：每张新卡落上来，已落定的整摞被压下再弹回——观众从物理反馈里读出"这是实打实攒下来的东西"。计数器同步跳格把数量感钉死。
cards.use: feed/雷达/收件箱类"每天有新东西"的镜头；强调持续积累的资产列表
cards.energy_text: 中

cards.name: morph-from-primitive
cards.summary_en: A circle anticipates with one breath, morphs into a rounded card outline, then reveals its content.
cards.intention: 入场库全是"从外面进来"——飞入、砸落、翻面，主体都预先存在于画外； 本卡是**就地长出来**：画面中心一个描边正圆先鼓一口气（scale 1→1.12→1），随即轮廓连续变形为圆角矩形卡片，内容再淡入。原型 停留加呼吸这一拍就是预备动作——迪士尼 anticipation 的图形学翻译： 圆先"吸气"，观众就知道它要变，变形本身因此不需要任何解释。 仅适用图形/图标/卡轮廓类主体——位图截图不能 morph。
cards.use: 图形/图标/卡轮廓类主体的入场；logo→UI 容器的经典原语
cards.duration_text: ~4.7s（呼吸 20f + 变形 24f + 内容淡入 12f）
cards.energy_text: 中低

cards.name: neon-frame-forerun
cards.summary_en: A neon frame races ahead to outline the scene in steep perspective while components drop from above and the page brightens as they land.
cards.intention: 先立框后填肉：霓虹线框像跑道灯一样两头奔画圈出位置，宣告 "这里要出现东西"；页面在框内由暗转亮的同时，组件从空中带影 贴落——观众看见界面被"安放"进框里。三层动作（框奔画/页面点亮/ 组件贴落）必须**同步咬合**：贴落进程与点亮进程同步推进、稍滞后 收尾，框光最终并入面板辉光。背景霓虹管群终段熄灭，把亮度让给 主角完成收束。
cards.use: 暗场品牌片里给 UI 面板做"登场仪式"（框先到、内容后落）；功能区首次亮相；霓虹/赛博调性的段落开场
cards.duration_text: 框奔画 ~0.6s + 点亮&贴落 ~2s + 背景熄灭收束 ~0.8s；全段 4–4.5s
cards.energy_text: 中高（三层动作叠进，但都服务同一次登场）

cards.name: neon-frame-orbit-drop
cards.summary_en: After a neon frame draws itself, the camera arcs left to right while every page component drops from the air and lands on the same frame.
cards.intention: neon-frame-forerun 的孪生变体：同样框先行、内容后落，但镜头 不是固定的——从页面左侧视角连续弧线旋转到右侧视角，旋转进行 的同时全部组件从空中贴落。命门是**同时贴合**：所有组件和文字 同帧起落、同帧贴合、软影同步消失——这是"整体登场"的语法 （判例：错峰版被裁"应该是所有组件和文字同时从空中往下贴合"）。 错峰贴落属于巡礼镜（graze-face-tour/runway），一页一次性亮相 必须齐落，节奏语义不能混用。
cards.use: 单页 UI 的一次性隆重登场（与巡礼/逐区亮相相对）；暗场霓虹调性段落的主视觉揭幕；neon-frame-forerun 的姊妹镜
cards.duration_text: 描框 ~0.5s + 旋转&同时贴落 ~2.5s + 落定 ~1s；全段 4–4.5s
cards.energy_text: 中高（一次性的大动作，落定即静）

cards.name: page-waterfall-wall
cards.summary_en: Real page captures flow at different speeds across a tilted 3D wall, creating an endless field of content.
cards.intention: 流动式一览：让观众在几秒内"看到很多页面流过"，读感是体量而非细节。 与 outro-group-photo-launch 分工：那是**聚拢式**一览（元素飞来围住 字标定格合影，语义"属于同一产品"），本卡是**流动式**一览（内容持续 流过不定格，语义"还有很多没给你看完"）。与 odometer-digit-roll 分工： 那是有终值的机械滚轮（逐位停稳读数字），本卡无终值无限循环。 与 wall-reveal-moves 分工：那是整墙**入场动作**，本卡是墙的**持续状态**， 可用那卡入场后交棒本卡续流。
cards.use: "多页面/多功能/多模板"体量感段落；montage 中段铺陈或 intro 后的产品广度镜头
cards.duration_text: 4–6s（无限循环体，时长由段落需要裁）
cards.energy_text: 中（流动陈列型）

cards.name: paper-craft-moves
cards.summary_en: Two paper gestures: masking tape slapping a floating card down, and cards rising from the page like a pop-up book.
cards.intention: Wes Anderson 手账美术与立体书纸艺的 UI 翻译。A：卡片轻飘入位后 悬着微晃（未固定的纸），两条撕边半透明胶带"啪、啪"先后拍在对角， 第二条拍下**同帧**卡片停晃、投影变薄、整卡下沉——"按死"的定妆 一瞬是主角，两声"啪"是天然音效点。B：整页平躺如摊开书页（俯视）， 卡片像贴在页上的纸片沿各自底边错峰立起成墙，立到 95° 回弹 90° （纸的韧性），根部投影随立起收窄。
cards.use: 纸墨主视觉片的实体材料语言：单卡定妆入场用 A、整版 dashboard 开场建立用 B；与纸墨+强调色的主视觉（模板片为纸/墨/琥珀）天然同源
cards.energy_text: A 中（两拍打击）/ B 中高（立墙有纵深冲击）

cards.name: platform-hinge-rise
cards.summary_en: A support platform establishes first, two subjects hinge upward from adjacent lower pivots, and a restrained outcome wedge rises last to turn evidence into a conclusion.
cards.intention: 先让平台成为可信的“承托关系”，再让两个主体从平台后方翻起，观众会自然把它们 理解为同组证据；最后从下方升起的结论台不是第三个平级元素，而是对前两者的归纳。 固定机位和明确的遮挡顺序让这张卡适合解释性 B-roll，也能换成产品卡、人物、建筑或 对比方案。核心不是“东西从下方出现”，而是**两个相邻铰点产生方向相反的展开力**。
cards.use: 两个主体/方案/品牌并列登场；建筑、设备、卡片从基座后升起；需要在一个固定机位里完成“先摆证据再下结论”的解释镜头
cards.duration_text: 约 3.5s（104f@30fps；结论落定后保留 30f 静止）
cards.energy_text: 中（中段双主体同时翻起是唯一主动作，结尾只做稳重升台）

cards.name: product-card-progressive-assemble
cards.summary_en: A product card builds itself field by field as image, title and pills pop in, the old price gets struck through while an accent new price springs out, and highlighter blocks sweep across the copy.
cards.intention: 一张详情卡直接淡入，观众只看到"有一张卡"。逐字段落位则把卡变成一份**正在被填写的 表单**：每个字段各自到位，观众的注意力被牵着走一遍卡的信息结构——图在哪、标题在哪、 价格在哪、正文重点在哪。价格划线降级是全片唯一的语义事件（不是"出现"而是"改变"）， 所以它被安排在中段最显眼的位置。
cards.use: 商品/条目详情页的能力展示；"结构化抽取""自动填充""数据自己长出来"类叙事的主镜头
cards.energy_text: 中（连续小事件密集排布，无单点爆发；靠前推保持推进感）

cards.name: radial-wave
cards.summary_en: A 17x9 dot grid lights up in rings that spread outward from the center, each dot overshooting its scale before settling into a steady glow, then a brighter pulse collapses back inward from the edges.
cards.intention: 把"很多点同时存在"这件静态事实，改写成"能量从一个源头扩散到全体"的动态事实。观众 看到的不是一张点阵图，而是一次通电：中心先亮，亮度像水波推过去，走完之后整张阵列 留在常亮态——为下一拍要放的内容铺好底。第二道反向波是回执，告诉观众这个系统会回应。
cards.use: 产品/品牌开场的"系统上电"一拍；也用作数据网格、节点地图、覆盖范围类叙事的建立镜头
cards.energy_text: 中高（起手爆发一次，波前过后转为常亮低能量底子）

cards.name: research-card-stack-scroll
cards.summary_en: Dark paper cards drop into the center every twelve frames and pile along a downward-right axis, squashing on landing while only the topmost card renders its full text as the rest blur into the stack.
cards.intention: 要说的是"数量"，但一次给 13 张卡会读成一堵墙。改成流水线：卡一张一张进，每张都被 读过（最上一张永远是全文渲染的那张），读完就沉进堆里变模糊。观众感受到的是持续不断 的吞吐量，而不是一个静态的堆。背景 grid 同速下移是速度参照——没有它，堆积会读作 "卡在原地缩小"。
cards.use: "读了大量资料/处理了海量文档"的量级交代；研究类、检索类、批处理类产品的能力镜头
cards.energy_text: 中高（匀速高频，无爆发但持续压迫）

cards.name: row-embed
cards.summary_en: Content rows descend with perspective, flatten into the page, and flash a thin amber seam at the moment of insertion.
cards.intention: 详情页的行不是"显示出来"而是"长进去"——每一行从空中降下并严丝合缝嵌入页面布局，嵌入瞬间的强调色缝是"咔哒"扣上的视觉拟音。
cards.use: "结构化数据长进页面"的详情页/列表镜头；行级内容的批量入场
cards.energy_text: 中

cards.name: runway-ground-skim
cards.summary_en: From a low runway angle, UI cards rain down in overlapping fast drops with zero bounce, then the finished page tilts upright to camera.
cards.intention: 把界面拍成跑道：低角度透视里 UI 卡片悬空在不同高度，随后按界面 位置顺序（行优先左→右）一阵急雨式贴落——掉落感=干脆利落。 三个命门：**重叠并行**（起点只错 1.5f、下落 9f ⇒ 空中恒有 5–6 张 同时在落，"几乎一起但有涟漪感"；串行等待两轮被裁）、**零回弹** （着地即停，弹起被裁）、**快**（下落 9f，15f 版被裁"快一点"）。 落齐后页面从躺倒立起（rotateX 66°→0°）、镜头拉远居中，观众从 "看戏"回到"看界面"。
cards.use: 仪表盘/卡片流界面的登场（内容"从天而降完成自己"）；低角度炫技段后的收正；clickup 系悬空贴落语言的"齐落"重型版
cards.duration_text: 悬空展示 ~0.4s + 贴落 ~1.2s + 立起转正 ~1.8s；全段 4s
cards.energy_text: 高（掉落感是戏眼，立起转正是收束）

cards.name: skeleton-reveal
cards.summary_en: Content develops in three stages — wobbling doodle placeholders, gray skeleton bars, then rows resolving into avatars and word-by-word text.
cards.intention: UI 登场库全是"整页一次到位"（飞入/落位/擦出）。本卡把登场拆成 **三级保真度跃迁**：手绘涂鸦（想法）→ 灰条骨架（结构）→ 真实内容 （产品），每次跃迁都是一拍"变成真的"的爽点，观众跟着走完"从草图 到产品"的叙事弧。骨架→内容的显影借的是加载态语法——用户天天见 skeleton screen，看到灰条就知道"内容要来了"，预期免费。与 document-typewriter-reveal 分工：那是**一份文档**被逐块写出来（内容是 主角、要读字）；本卡是**一个界面**逐级变真（结构是主角、字是最后 一级质感）。与 ai-stream-response 分工：那是证据行逐条"汇入"（列表 在生长），本卡是已就位的占位"显影"（布局早定，保真度在升级）。
cards.use: 产品 UI 的"从无到有"登场叙事；开场后第一次亮产品界面的段落
cards.duration_text: ~5.7s（172f：涂鸦 1s + 换真 0.3s + 骨架滚入 1.2s + 推近显影 3s）
cards.energy_text: 中（叙事型登场，重点是"变成真的"那两次跃迁）

cards.name: svg-shape-morph
cards.summary_en: A closed organic outline flows smoothly into a second shape and back again, interpolating 140 matched sample points while a faint scale breath, slow drift rotation and hue shift from cyan to violet ride on top.
cards.intention: "形态会变"这件事，用两张图交叉淡入是说不清的——观众看到的是两个东西重叠。真正的 morph 要让观众相信这一直是**同一个东西**在改变形状。等点数重采样加逐点插值就是这个 "同一性"的技术保证：没有点的生成或消失，只有半径在变。变回原形是为了闭环——观众 看到往返，才知道这是可逆的能力而不是一次性的变身。
cards.use: 抽象概念的"形态转换/自适应/有机生长"表达；开场 logo 前的氛围一拍，或章节之间的过渡形
cards.energy_text: 低（无爆点的连续流动，适合当旁白底或呼吸拍）

cards.name: value-stagger-gradient
cards.summary_en: Sixteen bars rise in a staggered sweep where height, hue, travel distance and blur are each spread as a gradient across the row, then a second beat re-origins the stagger at the center so the pulse amplitude fans out symmetrically.
cards.intention: stagger 通常只被用来错开时间。这张卡要说的是它还能错开**值**——同一个索引既决定 "什么时候动"，也决定"动到多少"。两拍是一组对照实验：第一拍原点在首位（梯度从左到 右单调铺开），第二拍原点换到中心（梯度以中轴对称铺开）。观众看到的不是两个动画， 而是同一个配方换了一个参数。屏幕上的代码字幕同步换成对应的 stagger 调用，明说这件事。
cards.use: 技法演示与参数化能力的展示镜头；也可直接当数据/频谱/均衡器类界面的入场
cards.energy_text: 中高（第一拍是连续铺开，第二拍中心脉冲是明确的一次峰值）

cards.name: wall-reveal-moves
cards.summary_en: Three in-place wall reveals: sequential bento lights, a wave of grid flips, and a wireframe drawing itself into a finished interface.
cards.intention: "一墙内容怎么出场"库内此前只有 deck-deal-flyin 一个答案——高能量、位移型、 "东西涌进来"。但不是每面墙都该涌：品牌段要庄重、功能墙要轻快、 "从设计到实物"要讲工序。这三式共同点是**非位移批量入场**——元素原地显形， 版式从第一帧就成立，观众看的是"状态变化的波前扫过一面墙"而不是"物体飞行"。 选型先问一句：这面墙该"涌进来"还是"亮起来"？前者去 deck-deal-flyin，后者进本卡。
cards.use: 功能墙/卡片墙/整页界面的整体亮相；内容已在原位、要"显形"而非"涌入"的段落
cards.duration_text: 单式约 4.3–5s（A 150f / B 130f / C 150f @30fps，含建立 hold 与静止收尾）
cards.energy_text: 中

cards.name: basic-3d-scene
cards.summary_en: Impress-style spatial slides: cards sit at scattered 3D poses and the camera flies to align with each one by inverting its transform, ending on a pulled-back overview where every card lights up.
cards.intention: 把"翻页"变成"在想法的空间里旅行"：每张卡不仅有位置还有姿态（第二步侧转 40°、第三步整个画框转 90°），相机对齐它时观众的世界也跟着转——空间变化本身成为"进入新章节"的仪式感。
cards.use: 概念/路线图/三步法的空间化讲述；替代平面 slides 的"每一步都换个空间视角"
cards.energy_text: 中（每次转场有空间惊喜，停留段安静读卡）

cards.name: crash-zoom-punch
cards.summary_en: A six-frame push races from a wide view to a target close-up, ending with either an elastic overshoot or a heavy impact stop.
cards.intention: 慢推近（spotlight-hero-card）是"请看"，急推是"看这个！"——一拍之内 从全景砸到特写，视线没有选择余地。落位质感分两款：回弹是弹性 （"看这个"），撞停震屏是重量（"就是它"），按强调级选。
cards.use: 功能段"点名"镜头——把观众视线一拍按到目标卡/模块上；强调级用撞停
cards.duration_text: 约 0.5s 动作 + 前后 hold（动作 6–11f，前 hold ≥30f 建立全景、后 hold ≥45f 读特写）
cards.energy_text: 高（瞬时冲击，非持续高能）

cards.name: cursor-flyover
cards.summary_en: After an overview fade-in the camera flies to each of four screen corners in turn while an SVG cursor arrives with it, pointing and leaving a click ripple at every stop.
cards.intention: 替代"四个功能四段剪辑"的省镜方案：一个连续相机把四个角串成一条参观动线，光标是观众的注意力代理——它到哪、点哪，观众就看哪。空间连续让功能之间的位置关系也被顺带记住。
cards.use: 单页产品的功能巡览：一镜带观众看完四个功能区，光标当"导游手指"
cards.duration_text: 约 6.0s（180f@30fps；俯瞰 0–1.2s · 四步各 0.7s 过渡 + 0.5s 停留）
cards.energy_text: 中（匀速巡航，节奏靠点击涟漪打点）

cards.name: depth-layer-moves
cards.summary_en: Two depth techniques: layered parallax rails and a simulated dolly zoom that pins the subject while the background expands.
cards.intention: 整页平移是"看页面"，分层深度是"在页面的空间里"。视差滑轨给横移 加纵深（迪士尼多平面摄影机原理，Linear 片同款质感）；伪 dolly-zoom 反过来——主角纹丝不动、全世界压过来，给戏剧性时刻蓄力。
cards.use: 平面截图要"有厚度"的段落；戏剧性蓄力时刻用 dolly-zoom（一支片 ≤1 次）
cards.duration_text: 视差滑轨 4–5s 持续；dolly-zoom 3–4s 单向行程
cards.energy_text: 视差=中（质感型）；dolly-zoom=中高（压迫感渐强）

cards.name: graze-face-tour
cards.summary_en: The camera skims low across the UI surface like terrain while page text hovers above the interface and settles down as the shot advances.
cards.intention: 把 UI 拍成地形：大倾角特写让侧栏树、导航、列表行变成掠过的地貌， 浅景深强化"贴面"。戏眼是**文字空中贴落**：文字/组件不是原地淡入， 而是悬浮在界面上空（3D z 轴抬高），在空中时往界面投同形软影， 随镜头行进先后加速贴落、影子随高度收敛消失——观众看见界面在 镜头经过时"完成自己"。影子是可感命门：没有影子，悬浮读作 普通位移入场；有影子，空间关系瞬间成立。
cards.use: 功能区巡礼（把 UI 当地景飞掠）；配合暗场+霓虹缘光做产品"内部世界"段落；界面内容逐区登场
cards.energy_text: 中高（运镜持续推进+元素连续落位，信息密度高）

cards.name: overhead-camera-moves
cards.summary_en: Two overhead reveals: a tilted scene leveling into view, and a tabletop layout dropping sharply into place.
cards.intention: 库内俯拍视角一直空缺——crane-rise 是"平移+缩放"的升起（俯仰角 不动），space-camera C 式 drone-dive 是俯冲降落一镜到底；这两式让 **俯仰角本身讲故事**：A 是揭示——整页 rotateX 平躺、开场只见上缘 一条透视窄带，机位"抬头"回正，内容一排排涌入视野，像掀开桌上的 图纸；B 是选择——三张页面卡平躺成桌面卡阵，相机俯拍横向滑过依次 掠过（韦斯·安德森 tabletop），滑到目标页猛地俯冲扎入、抬正成满屏， "巡视一圈，就选这张"。选型：单页开场用 A，多页转场/开场用 B。
cards.use: 用"俯仰角"讲故事的开场/转场：单页 establishing 用 A，多页巡视择一扎入用 B
cards.energy_text: A 中 / B 中高

cards.name: space-camera-moves
cards.summary_en: Three spatial camera moves: exploded assembly, subject-locked rotation, and a drone-like dive to the landing point.
cards.intention: depth-layer 卡是给平移加纵深——层在动、页面还是页面。这两式更进一步： 整页被当成一个 3D 实体，相机（或世界）绕着它做实拍级机动。两式叙事 语义各占一格：A 说"看看它由什么组成"（拆解展示，Apple 发布片语言）； C 说"从全局俯瞰砸到主角"（上帝视角一头扎进 hero 特写，全景→焦点）。
cards.use: 把平面页面当 3D 实体拍的高光段落；两式都是"大动作"，一支片合计 ≤2 次
cards.duration_text: A 5s（炸开-悬停-合体全程）；C 3–5s 单向俯冲
cards.energy_text: 高

cards.name: steep-tilt-glide
cards.summary_en: A page stands at a steep 60-degree perspective and glides across a fixed camera with speed ghosting while text settles onto the surface mid-flight.
cards.intention: 把页面立成一堵斜墙：镜头钉死不动，60° 强透视让右缘贴脸、左缘 消失在灭点，页面自己沿自身平面横向滑移——内容像列车车厢一样 依次掠过。命门是**物动镜不动**：perspective/origin/rotY 全程常数， 唯一动的量是页面局部 translateX——镜头一动语义就变成运镜炫技， 这里的戏是"页面在自我展示"。角度经三轮收敛为精确 60° （-45°"不对"→-53°"再大一点"→-60°选中）。
cards.use: 长页面/多区块 UI 的炫技巡览（内容依次滑过固定机位）；暗场霓虹调性；与贴面运镜卡互补的"侧掠"机位
cards.energy_text: 中高（透视炫技+持续运动，但节奏是匀的）

cards.name: tension-camera-moves
cards.summary_en: Four emotional camera tools: frozen orbit, Dutch roll correction, slow pressure push, and an isolating pull-back.
cards.intention: space-camera-moves 三式是"把页面当 3D 实体拍"的高光炫技；这四式相反—— 动作本身克制，全部劲道在情绪语义上：A 说"这一刻值得停下时间看" （运动中的元素被冻住、相机绕行审视）；B 说"问题解决了，世界被扶正" （斜角悬着的难受感在节拍上滚回水平）；C 说"有什么要发生了"（慢到 不自觉的推近积压张力，顶点硬切释放）；D 说"最后只剩这一件事" （后拉中周围逐层熄灭，孤悬一点收束全片）。四式各占一个情绪格， 是分镜阶段"这一段观众该感到什么"的直接词汇。
cards.use: 情绪节点（震撼/纠偏/积压/收束）的运镜语言；与 space-camera-moves 的"炫技大动作"互补——这四式动作小、情绪重
cards.duration_text: 单式 4–5s；全片合计 ≤2 式（各 ≤1 次）
cards.energy: A 高 / B 中 / C 低压升 / D 低收
cards.energy_text: A 高 / B 中 / C 低压升 / D 低收

cards.name: terminal-3d
cards.summary_en: Three terminal windows float at different poses in 3D space; the camera flies between them with a sine pull-back, and at each stop a command types out and its results slide in line by line.
cards.intention: 终端输出天生是"平面滚动"的反电影语言，这张卡把它空间化：每条命令占据空间中一个实体窗口，相机像穿过机房一样逐窗拜访。飞行途中的拉远让观众瞥见"还有更多窗口"——工作流的全貌感。
cards.use: 开发者产品的 CLI/工作流演示：把"三步命令"拍成三站空间旅程
cards.duration_text: 约 6.0s（180f@30fps；三站各约 1.6s 停留 + 0.85s 飞行）
cards.energy_text: 中（飞行给动感、打字给节奏，整体是沉稳的技术叙事）

cards.name: avatar-grid-radial-build-colorize
cards.summary_en: A card grid grows ring by ring from the center — tiles holding initials, icons, or image placeholders — then about fifteen percent of them flush red at random moments to surface anomalies.
cards.intention: 两幕结构：第一幕"群体成形"——卡片从中心一环环长出，像镜头下的菌落生长；第二幕"异常浮现"——铺满后个别卡片陆续变红，观众的眼睛被迫扫描全场找红点。它把"我们帮你盯着所有项"这句话拍成了体验。
cards.use: "群体中浮现异常/重点"的数据叙事：用户群健康度、监控面板、批量状态总览
cards.energy_text: 中（生长段有节奏感，染色段是安静的"发现"时刻）

cards.name: before-after-slider-scrub
cards.summary_en: Before and after views share one frame while a fast-then-slow slider reveals the processed result.
cards.intention: AI 图像产品发布片的标准对比语法：同一画面"处理前"（低对比灰蒙） 与"处理后"（清晰版）叠放，带圆手柄的竖分割杆先从左端猛甩到 70% （overshoot 回弹）、停一拍，再以约 1/5 的速度慢扫回来让观众看清 差异——**快甩慢扫的速度对比就是节奏**：快甩宣告"变了"， 慢扫证明"变在哪"。
cards.use: AI 增强/优化/重构类功能的效果对比段落（"用前 vs 用后"一镜讲清）
cards.energy_text: 中（快甩是打击点，慢扫是阅读期）

cards.name: chart-live-moves
cards.summary_en: Three data-driven motions: a live oscilloscope trace, dots regrouping into a figure, and an axis forced to rescale.
cards.intention: 图表不是插图是剧情。三式共同前提（实测判例）：**必须真图表语境** ——真轴标/真数据/真文案，灰阶占位条测不出数据叙事的表达力。 A 示波流线：曲线写入点钉在右端上下起伏，旧数据左流出画，中途一次 突发尖峰（振幅 2.2×、读数跳大变强调色）——"实时"不用说出口，还有事件； B 点阵重组：320 个点（每点≈40 customers）散布→聚三簇（浮 Free/Pro/ Enterprise 真标签）→列队成柱（真轴标）→聚成点阵大数字 "12,847"—— 同一批点，观众能跟着某一颗看它归队； C 轴爆表：折线正常爬升，新值顶破图表上沿冲出卡片 220px（强调色粗线 插进标题区），停半拍，y 轴"哗"地重标（旧刻度飞出/新刻度滑入/网格 加密/旧线压扁成地平线），新值落回+弹真值标签——用"坐标轴装不下"演增长。
cards.use: 数据叙事段落；分别讲"实时性"、"每个数字是一个人"、"增长装不下"
cards.energy_text: 中高（数据即剧情）

cards.name: counter-confetti
cards.summary_en: A large counter sprints up with ease-out-quart and an overshoot scale while 52 confetti pieces burst in from both sides on real gravity arcs — deliberately half a beat before the number lands.
cards.intention: 数字不是"显示"出来的，是"冲线"的：计数曲线前快后慢像百米冲刺进入慢镜，纸屑在数字到位**之前**抢拍爆开——庆祝比结果先到半拍，情绪压过信息，观众先兴奋再看清数字。
cards.use: 里程碑/成绩数字的庆祝拍：用户数、营收、下载量等"值得开香槟"的指标揭示
cards.energy_text: 高（计数蓄力 + 爆点释放，标准的情绪峰值镜头）

cards.name: cycle-glass-node-morph
cards.summary_en: One subject shrinks through a diagonal wipe into a three-stage cycle, then a continuous push-in lets three glass nodes rise and take over the labels before diagnostic markers lock the system state.
cards.intention: 循环图最容易沦为“画三个圆加两支箭头”。本卡把机制解释建立在一个连续主体上： 主体不是被另一份灰阶副本替换，而是在对角擦除发生时同步缩入系统中心；循环文字先作为 黑色概念标签出现，推近后玻璃节点从它们下方升起，把同一标签转为白色节点标题。 观众因此读到的是**场景里的对象被解释成一套运行机制**，而不是切到另一页 PPT。
cards.use: AI agent/自动化/控制系统的感知—推理—执行循环；“一个对象背后有三段机制”的解释镜头；从真实场景过渡到抽象系统图的技术型 B-roll
cards.energy_text: 中高（前段场景转换，中段循环建立，后段推近与三节点连续顶起）

cards.name: gauge-readout-moves
cards.summary_en: Two instrument reads: a full-range needle self-test and a moving scale that races beneath a fixed pointer.
cards.intention: 把"报数值"做成仪表的身体动作：A 是汽车点火自检——表盘指针先"唰"地 甩满全弧（270°）再回落定格真实值，多表错峰成波浪，先亮量程再报数， 开场宣誓感；B 是飞机空速带语法——指针/取景窗钉死画面正中，带刻度的 标尺整体从底下滚过，大数值跳变时刻度带 45px/f 冲刺、末尾 spring 刹车 带回摆过冲，"世界动、针不动"，数值大小变成看得见的位移距离。 与 odometer-digit-roll 分工：那是数字在窗里滚，B 是连刻度格线全在平移。
cards.use: dashboard 开场仪式/性能指标揭晓；A 多表盘开机感，B 单指标大跳变
cards.energy_text: 中高（机械仪式型）

cards.name: hatch-depth
cards.summary_en: Hatched placeholder bars wipe out to length one by one, then cross-fade into solid accent-colored data bars with values popping at their tips and a LIVE header sliding in.
cards.intention: 把"占位符变成真数据"这个产品瞬间拍成看得见的材质转换：先用 45° 斜纹条画出"这里将有数据"的草稿感，再让实心色层原位替换——几何完全不动、只换皮肤，观众读到的是"同一样东西活了"。
cards.use: "从草稿到真实数据"的叙事拍；dashboard/报表功能引入，或强调数据实时性的段落
cards.energy_text: 中（信息渐进，无爆点，靠质感转换制造"上线了"的瞬间）

cards.name: odometer-digit-roll
cards.summary_en: A full-screen metric rolls each digit like an odometer, overshoots into place, and pulses when every column locks.
cards.intention: 王牌数字的登场库内有"砸"（score-slam）和"弹"（damage-number）， 都是位移系。本卡是**机械系**：数字不是飞进来的，是"算出来的"—— 每位一条 0–9 滚轮高速转动，从左到右逐位减速、过冲半格、咔哒锁定， Vercel Ship/Stripe Sessions 指标段的标准语法。滚动过程自带悬念 （它会停在几？），逐位锁定自带节奏（哒、哒、哒、哒），比直接显示 终值多一整拍的期待感。与 VerticalTicker（backlog 待选）的区别： 有终值、逐位停稳，不是无限滚动墙。
cards.use: 单个王牌指标的全屏亮相（"10x"/"99.98%"级）；与 impact-feedback B 式（伤害数字弹出）分工——那是元素级配菜，这是全屏级主菜
cards.duration_text: 滚动+逐位锁定 ~63f + 脉冲 8f + hold ≥45f，约 5s
cards.energy_text: 中高

cards.name: particle-celebrate-hits
cards.summary_en: Two celebration accents: crossing confetti cannons and sparks emitted when a counter passes a milestone.
cards.intention: 给"数字揭晓"配可听感的视觉打点：A 是揭晓瞬间的句号——画面左下右下 两门炮同帧开火，上百颗翻转彩屑抛物线交叉飞过全屏再落出画外，纯庆祝 语义；B 是过程中的逗号——计数器每跳过一个整千，数字顶部"叮"地溅一撮 小火星坠落熄灭，终值那跳翻倍爆一大撮+数字弹 1.1x。两式都是闭式弹道 （初速+重力+衰减逐帧公式），免物理引擎、帧确定。
cards.use: 里程碑数字/KPI 揭晓/成就段落；A 一次性大庆祝，B 持续小打点
cards.energy_text: 高潮点缀型（爆发后必须落回纯净静止）

cards.name: particle-sand-fill
cards.summary_en: Chart columns form from falling square particles, solidify when full, and finish with a value pop.
cards.intention: 把柱状图入场从"长高动画"换成"落体堆积"：每根柱上方下一场方块雨， 粒子逐颗坠落（重力加速）、触堆积面即停+15% 回弹，一层压一层堆到目标 高度后粒子面淡出换实体柱、顶部数值标签弹出。数据的"量"变成看得见的 "一颗一颗攒出来"——与 unit-dot-swarm-regroup（点群平面迁徙聚形） 分工：那是同一批点改队形，这是落体材料筑成图形。
cards.use: 柱状图/量级对比入场；讲"积累/汇聚"语义的数据段落
cards.energy_text: 中高（构筑感入场）

cards.name: ring-diagram-annotation-reveal
cards.summary_en: A full-frame subject collapses into a concentric mechanism diagram, adds segmented rings and inward arrows, then shifts left to make room for a readable annotation column.
cards.intention: 直接出现一张环形图，观众只会把它当作静态信息图。本卡先让主体占满全画面，再用 收缩的圆形窗口把“内容”压成一个可分析对象；细环、分段环与向心箭头依次补齐机制， 最后整组退到左侧，右栏才给出名称和解释。视觉顺序因此是**先经历对象，再理解结构， 最后阅读定义**，适合科技、工程、数据和概念科普。
cards.use: 把抽象名词解释成结构图；系统/装置/流程的“主体→机制→注释”镜头；需要先制造沉浸特写、再退成可读说明图的横屏 B-roll
cards.duration_text: 约 6.3s（190f@30fps；最终构图保留 30f 可读时间）
cards.energy_text: 中高（前半段几何持续建立，后半段转为信息阅读）

cards.name: scroll-brake-moves
cards.summary_en: Two fast-scroll stops: a long page decelerating precisely onto a target, and the same stop paired with a locking reticle.
cards.intention: Linear changelog 视频语法：一整年的更新日志作为长卷高速掠过 （糊成色带），指数减速精准急刹停在本次发布那条上，该条抬升离面 高亮、其余退暗——密度感讲"一直在发货"，急停讲"今天这条最大"。 B 是组合变异：急刹帧**同帧**四个 L 角标从画外飞入咬合锁定停点 条目——急刹的"哐"与咬合的"咔"叠在同一帧共振（组合命门： 角标起跳帧=列表首停帧，错开退化成两招并置）。
cards.use: changelog/发布史/长列表段落："一直在发货，今天这条最大"；要给停点更强打击感用 B
cards.energy_text: 高开中收（速度对比型）

cards.name: timeline-travel
cards.summary_en: The camera accelerates along a horizontal version timeline, raises cards at each stop, then brakes sharply on the final milestone.
cards.intention: 把产品的版本史拍成一次沿时间轴的旅行（《反恐王国》片头判例）： 镜头缓起→冲刺→急刹三段变速横移，v1.0/v2.0/v3.0 刻度依次掠过， 每过一格对应卡片从刻度线上 spring 弹立——历史在窗外闪过， 急停在"今天"并推近。速度本身讲"发展快"，急停讲"现在最重要"。
cards.use: changelog/里程碑/发展史段落（"我们一直在发货"的另一种拍法）；与 scroll-brake-moves 分工：那卡是纵向列表急刹，本卡是横向时间旅行
cards.energy_text: 中高（加速→急刹的节奏型镜头）

cards.name: ai-stream-response
cards.summary_en: A readable AI summary lands first, followed by evidence rows that stream in and resolve into a completed state.
cards.intention: 把“AI 正在工作”拍成可读的因果链，而不是日志刷屏：观众先看懂答案摘要， 再看到证据/子任务逐条补齐，最后由完成态确认这轮工作结束。
cards.use: AI 助手/agent/search/copilot 的结果生成镜头；强调“结论先到、证据随后、任务完成”
cards.energy_text: 中高（信息持续增加，但阅读优先于速度炫技）

cards.name: autolayout-gap-dial
cards.summary_en: A gap value dial pushes a row of blocks apart in real time while badge digits tick, then everything springs back into place.
cards.intention: "参数改了、UI 变了"是设计工具的核心承诺，但通常拍成"点面板→切 结果"的前后对比，因果被剪掉了。本卡把因果拍成连续镜头：间距徽章 数字逐格跳，链接块**同帧**被推开，测量线实时拉长——数字就是缰绳， 布局就是马。框选描边+8 手柄+间距标注全是设计工具的母语，观众一眼 认出"这是在工具里调参数"。回程故意用欠阻尼弹簧过冲（缩到比起点 更紧再回稳），把"归位"做成一次有弹性的收尾。与 type-and-filter 分工：那是"输入内容→列表收敛"的检索因果，本卡是"拨数值→几何 重排"的参数因果。
cards.use: 设计工具/低代码产品的"改一个数、界面跟着动"卖点镜头；"用设计工具语义做包装"的品类语言
cards.duration_text: ~4s（120f：框选入场 + 拉松 38f + hold + 弹簧回弹）
cards.energy_text: 中（工具理性型，爽点在数字与位移的锁定同步）

cards.name: canvas-materialize-moves
cards.summary_en: Two materialize moves: table rows arc out of a panel and morph into canvas cards, and a typed prompt grows a cascading diagram tree.
cards.intention: 库内生成叙事只有"面板内流式写入"（ai-stream-response 证据行汇入面板） 和"图表自己活起来"（chart-live-moves），没有词管**内容离开容器、在 开放画布上物化成新实体**。本卡补这一块：画布是舞台，生成物是登台的 演员。A 式的命门是跨容器形态迁移——同一条内容从"行"变成"卡"，位置 /宽高/圆角/内容布局在一条 spring 上同步插值，观众读到"是它飞过去 变的"而不是"删一个加一个"；B 式的命门是级联时序——线牵出节点、层 喂出层，结构感来自先后而非同时。
cards.use: AI/协作工具"生成结果落到画布上"的叙事段落；A 式讲"已有内容换了个存在形态"，B 式讲"从一句话长出一棵结构"
cards.energy_text: 中

cards.name: chip-grid-single-select-blackout
cards.summary_en: Five option chips fade in, then a single grey press frame flashes before the chosen chip turns solid black with a tiny bounce while the others drop to eighteen percent without moving.
cards.intention: 一帧灰闪 + 三帧反黑，是把真实 UI 的 `:active → :selected` 两级状态 拆开演。观众看到的是"手指按下"再"系统确认"，而不是一次渐变。其余 chip 降到 18% 而**位置绝不移动**：一旦重排，观众会以为页面刷新了， "单选"的语义就丢了。
cards.use: 单选/套餐/档位选择的交互演示；"选了它之后会怎样"的因果镜头；价格/参数结算类链路
cards.energy_text: 中低（唯一的爆点是那一帧灰闪，其余都在收）

cards.name: chip-lift-to-user-pill
cards.summary_en: One chip in a grid hard-cuts to inverted black, the rest fade out in distance order, and the black chip grows rightward into a pill that types out a name and links to a badge.
cards.intention: 让"选中"这件事有**两段完全不同的质感**：选中瞬间是硬的（3 帧台阶化反色， 像真实 UI 的 `:active`），选中之后是软的（药丸生长、逐字打字、绿点点亮）。 其余 chip 按距离交错淡出，是在告诉观众"注意力从这里开始收拢"—— 距离排序比时间排序重要，因为它给出了空间上的因果。
cards.use: "从一堆候选里选中并展开这一个"的交互链路；协作/通讯录/收件人类产品的功能演示；选中→详情的转场
cards.energy_text: 中（选中那一下是硬爆点，之后全是从容的生长与打字）

cards.name: collab-cursor-moves
cards.summary_en: Two cursor performances: a duet of collaborator cursors dancing in a dark scene, and a five-cursor ensemble drifting and typing as ambience.
cards.intention: 库内光标一直是"操作工具"（input-trigger-moves 的 cursor-performance 是单光标点击表演）。本卡把带身份名牌的协作光标升格成**演员**： A 式两枚具名光标在纯暗场用位移编排讲"设计-开发交接"——没有一个 UI 元素，观众照样看懂了剧情，光标位置关系就是台词；B 式五枚光标错峰 入场后持续漂移当氛围粒子，"团队在场"感全靠它，其中一枚还能停下来 打字（cameo 戏份）。SVG 光标+名牌 chip 成本极低、叙事密度极高， 是"协作"主题最便宜的视觉论证。
cards.use: 协作/多人/交接主题的叙事段；A 撑起无 UI 的纯叙事拍，B 给画布场景铺"团队在场"体温
cards.energy_text: A 中（叙事密度高）/ B 低中（氛围层，可垫任何时长）

cards.name: command-palette-summon
cards.summary_en: The screen dims and blurs as a command palette drops in, populates results, and narrows while the query is typed.
cards.intention: Raycast/Linear 发布片的标志性仪式：一声轻响，整个 UI 世界压暗 让路，⌘K 面板从中心上方弹落，候选列表错峰浮现；敲两个字母， 列表实时收窄——"你要的一切都在这个输入框里"。模拟交互按真人 操作速度走（R3），收窄的"挤压感"来自行高塌缩而非淡出。
cards.use: 效率型产品的"全产品在一个输入框里"叙事；命令面板/搜索/快捷键功能的标志性登场
cards.energy_text: 中（仪式感型，弹落帧与收窄是两个小打击点）

cards.name: glass-pill-dictation-typing
cards.summary_en: A fixed-width glass pill pops in slightly oversized and settles, glowing with an accent gradient inside that fades out as a placeholder sentence types across it.
cards.intention: 用"光随输入熄灭"讲一件很小的事：待命时它在发光（等你说话），你一开口 它就把光让给文字。1.7s 里只做三件事——弹出、打字、光退。任何额外动作 （弹跳、色变、图标动画）都会让这一拍不再是休止符。
cards.use: 语音/AI 输入框的登场；"跟它说话"的交互提示镜头；高能段之间的一个安静过渡拍
cards.energy_text: 低（全片最安静的一拍，只有光在退）

cards.name: hashtag-to-pill-materialize
cards.summary_en: 'A typed "#word" hard-cuts into a wide pill tag, holds, shrinks into its slot on the page, then hard-cuts again to reveal the finished view.'
cards.intention: 文字变实体的常规做法是渐变/morph/展开，原片帧级拆解证明 Bear 反着 来：**实体化是 1 帧硬切**——上一帧还是文字+光标，下一帧就是完整 胶囊，无展开无 cross-fade 无回弹。硬切给的是"啪、成了"的确定感， 任何渐变都会把"实体"软化成"特效"。全段骨架是**两次硬切夹一次 滑动**：硬切实体化 → 平滑缩移归位 → 硬切揭示成品页。唯一的连续 运动（缩移）被两记硬切框住，才显得又快又稳。这个节奏骨架是命门， 三段挪动任何一段的性质（把硬切改渐变、把滑动改硬切）整卡就塌。
cards.use: 标签/分类/关键词功能的演示段（笔记 app 打 tag、话题聚合）；"输入 → 变成 UI 实体 → 归位到成品"的三段式叙事
cards.duration_text: 打字 ~40f + 硬切胶囊 hold ~18f + 缩移 ~14f + 硬切揭示后静置；全段约 3.5s（原片 18–21.5s）
cards.energy_text: 中（干脆利落，靠硬切给劲，不靠弹跳）

cards.name: input-trigger-moves
cards.summary_en: Two input triggers: a performing cursor, and a key strike used as a hard-cut fuse.
cards.intention: 发布片的第一人称语法——观众不是在"看"产品，是在"用"产品：光标 是手、键帽是指尖、触发即叙事。两式共同点：**交互动作当扳机，产品 画面当枪响**。A 是慢扳机——放大光标带性格地滑入点击，镜头以点击点 推近再缓退，有去有回（区别 crash-zoom：慢速、锚定光标、会回来）； C 是引信——假 3D 键帽（⌘K）呼吸悬浮，3f 压扁+底部亮环溢出当引信， 按下引爆 30f 满屏轰鸣，最高潮一帧猛切成整齐静止全景， 按下→爆发→定论。选型：演示交互用 A，开场即高潮用 C。
cards.use: 发布片的第一人称段落：演示核心交互、开场即高潮；观众"在用"而不是"在看"产品
cards.energy_text: A 中 / C 高

cards.name: picker-carousel-feature-cycle
cards.summary_en: A vertical mobile-style picker holds its focus pill still while the list passes through it, each item decelerating hard into place and resting for several frames before the next.
cards.intention: 把"选择"这件事的物理感做出来：焦点框是固定的，是内容在滚动并被吸住。 每项停下后必须**真的静止几帧**——连续滚动读作 loading 动画，停顿才读作 "这一项被选中了"。距离衰减（透明度 + 字号 + 灰度三通道同时衰减）是让 观众视线始终锁在中间那一行的唯一手段。
cards.use: 逐个念出功能名/场景名的列表镜头；"选一个"的交互演示；移动端产品的 picker 类控件展示
cards.energy_text: 中（每一次吸附都是一个节拍点，5 拍匀速推进）

cards.name: segmented-thumb-hero
cards.summary_en: An oversized segmented control gets a close-up: a cursor slides in, presses, and the white thumb snaps to the other segment as icons swap with a spring.
cards.intention: 产品切到新模式，通常拍法是整个界面换掉。本卡反着来：把 segmented control 放大到 1080px 宽拍特写，**thumb 那 8 帧位移本身就是叙事**—— "我们从 A 走到了 B"。没有任何页面上下文，控件即舞台。因果链完整： 光标滑入（有人来了）→ 按下+涟漪（做了决定）→ thumb 滑动（世界响应） → 新图标弹出（新身份确立）。四拍缺一不可，缺了光标就是 UI 自己在动， 缺了图标弹出就是切换没有奖励。
cards.use: "模式切换/二选一"功能的宣告镜头（Ask→Computer、Chat→Agent 式）；一个 UI 微交互撑一整镜的特写拍法
cards.duration_text: ~3.5s（demo 110f：浮入 18f + 光标 24f + 点击 + 滑动 8f + 图标弹出 + hold）
cards.energy_text: 中（微交互特写，精致不轰）

cards.name: theme-switch-moves
cards.summary_en: Two theme-change patterns: a diagonal sweep that recolors content in place, and a command-palette ripple with a clear cause and effect.
cards.intention: 深浅模式切换的两种拍法。A（Notion/Figma/Linear 惯用）：15° 斜向 边界带亮线从左上扫到右下，边界经过处浅色**就地**变深色，同布局 双主题共存一瞬——观众看到的是"同一个 UI 换肤"，不是转场。 B（组合变异）：⌘K 面板输入 "dark" 回车，面板收缩成一个亮点， 深色涟漪**从该点**荡开扫过全 UI——"命令引发换肤"的因果链完整可读。 组合命门：涟漪圆心必须是面板收缩点、起始帧必须是收缩完成帧。
cards.use: 深色模式/主题功能的叙事段落；同一 UI "在你眼前变色"而非切到新场景
cards.energy_text: A 中 / B 中高（组合款有完整因果链）

cards.name: type-and-filter
cards.summary_en: A real interface types a search, collapses the grid to one result, then clicks through into the detail view.
cards.intention: 让观众"跟着做一遍"：看清输入了什么、页面怎么响应、点了哪里。这是全片唯一模拟真人操作的镜头，节奏必须像人手，不能像脚本。
cards.use: 功能演示的"操作叙事"段；搜索/筛选/进入详情的任何交互链路
cards.energy_text: 中（发牌高能段之后的从容一拍）

cards.name: voice-waveform-live
cards.summary_en: A recording capsule shows 64 live bars that surge with speech, shrink to a dotted line in pauses, and collapse on submit.
cards.intention: 库里唯一的波形是 spectrum-morph-ui——那是标题下划线裂成频谱条的 **装饰性**音乐可视化。本卡是**功能性**声纹："正在听你说"的实时 回执。区别在因果：spectrum 跟 BGM 跳、是包装；本卡跟"用户说话" 跳、是产品功能本身。说话时波形高耸、停顿时缩成一排点线、历史向左 滚出——观众从波形的起伏读出"它真的在听"，一段 6s+ 的画面全靠这份 活性撑住，不需要任何别的内容。与 gauge-readout-moves 分工：仪表是 "报一个数值"的机械仪式，本卡是"持续监听"的生命体征，没有终值。
cards.use: 语音输入/AI 助手"正在听你说"的功能镜头；无 UI 内容可展示但需要持续活性撑画面的段落
cards.energy_text: 中（功能性活性，不是炫技）

cards.name: bottom-push-stack-wipe
cards.summary_en: Each new scene pushes up from the bottom edge with its own saturated background color, physically shoving the old scene out of frame.
cards.intention: wipe-transitions 是一条边界扫过、新旧页都不动；page-turn 是立方体 翻转。本卡是第三种物性：**新章把旧章顶出去**——两屏刚性接触、同速 同向位移，像自动售货机压栈。命门是"连底色整屏走"：底色+窗口卡+装饰 条焊成一块整料从底边推入，观众读到"换了个世界"而不是"换了张卡"。 重 ease-out（快进慢停）给推入一个"哐"的落位感；上缘 40px 接缝阴影 是两屏物理接触的证据。连推三章且底色饱和度拉满，换章本身就成了全片 的节拍器——slack 原片全片就靠这一招做骨架。
cards.use: 多章节产品片的换章骨架（每章一个卖点一种底色）；需要"翻页节奏感"贯穿全片的段落切换
cards.duration_text: 单次推入 30f + 章内 hold ~1s；demo 三连推 140f（~4.7s）
cards.energy_text: 中

cards.name: bubble-swarm-takeover
cards.summary_en: Pearlescent bubbles drift in and swell until they cover the screen, hiding the scene switch at peak coverage before scattering to reveal the new page.
